documents.title: Underwater
documents.tagline: 7 miles below the ocean surface something has awakened
documents.overview: After an earthquake destroys their underwater station, six researchers must navigate two miles along the dangerous, unknown depths of the ocean floor to make it to safety in a race against time.
documents.plot:
Underwater is a 2020 American science fiction horror film directed by William Eubank and written by Adam Sztykiel. The movie stars Kristen Stewart, Vincent Cassel, Mamoudou Athie, and Jessica Henwick.

The story begins with Dr. Kate Elliott (Kristen Stewart), a marine biologist who has spent her entire life studying the ocean's depths. She is part of an underwater research team that conducts experiments in the Mariana Trench, the deepest point in the ocean. The team is led by Dr. Ian Garvey (Vincent Cassel), a renowned expert on deep-sea creatures.

During one of their dives, the team discovers a massive, alien-like creature that has been living in the trench for millions of years. As they try to collect samples from the creature, it suddenly attacks and kills several members of the team. The remaining crew members are forced to flee in terror as the creature begins to hunt them down.

As the situation spirals out of control, Kate realizes that the creature is not just a mindless beast - it's an intelligent, highly adaptable organism that has been living in the trench for millions of years. She also discovers that the creature is capable of surviving in extreme conditions, including crushing pressure and near-freezing temperatures.

As the crew tries to escape the trench, they realize that their only hope is to find a way to communicate with the creature. Kate uses her knowledge of marine biology to try and understand the creature's behavior, while also trying to keep her team safe from its deadly attacks.

Throughout the movie, the tension builds as the crew faces one terrifying challenge after another. They must navigate treacherous underwater caverns, avoid deadly sea creatures, and confront their own personal demons in order to survive.

As the story unfolds, Kate begins to realize that the creature is not just a monster - it's also a symbol of the ocean's power and fury. She comes to understand that the creature is trying to communicate with her, and that it may hold the key to unlocking the secrets of the deep sea.

In the end, Kate and her team manage to escape the trench, but not without scars. They realize that they have been changed forever by their encounter with the alien creature, and that they will never look at the ocean in the same way again.

Overall, Underwater is a tense, thrilling horror movie that explores the unknown dangers of the deep sea. With its stunning underwater visuals and terrifying creature design, it's sure to leave audiences on the edge of their seats.

documents.title: Hellraiser: Judgment
documents.tagline: Evil Seeks Evil.
documents.overview: Detectives Sean and David Carter are on the case to find a gruesome serial killer terrorizing the city. Joining forces with Detective Christine Egerton, they dig deeper into a spiraling maze of horror that may not be of this world.
documents.plot:
In Hell, Pinhead from the Cenobite sect, and the Auditor of the Stygian Inquisition are discussing how to adapt their methods of harvesting souls in the face of advancing human technology that is making the Configurations—gateways to Hell—obsolete. Meanwhile on Earth, three detectives—brothers Sean and David Carter, and Christine Egerton—investigate a serial killer known as the Preceptor, whose murders are based on the Ten Commandments.
A connection with one of the victims leads the detectives to Karl Watkins, a local criminal who went missing near an abandoned house. Sean goes there and loses consciousness, waking up in the Stygian Inquisition's domain in Hell. As the Inquisition prepares to hand down a verdict on Sean for his sins, the angel Jophiel intervenes and tells them to release him. Sean escapes the realm with a stolen puzzle box, and the Auditor requests Pinhead's guidance on the matter. Sean and David return to search the house, finding no trace of Hell or the Inquisition. That night he is haunted by visions of the Cenobites and Hell's denizens, who promise "judgment and redemption" to anyone who opens the box.
Sean and Christine go to the coroner Hodges' office and find that a cell phone of one of the Preceptor's victims was stored in her body, recording her final location with its GPS. They find the Preceptor's hideout, where Sean incapacitates Christine and reveals himself as the killer. David deduces the Preceptor's identity and meets with Hodges to find the building. Upon arrival, Sean disarms David and reveals that he is holding his wife Alison hostage, outraged that she had an affair. He forces David and Alison to open the box at gunpoint, summoning the Cenobites and opening a gateway to their realm.
Aware that someone from Hell would come to collect his soul after his initial escape, Sean attempts to offer Alison and David to Pinhead. Pinhead tells him they will be dealt with for opening the box, but because a separate faction of Hell wanted his soul, no deal will be made. The Auditor appears, telling Sean the Inquisition has found him guilty of his sins. Jophiel intervenes again and protests to Pinhead and the Auditor that Sean is part of Heaven's plan to instill fear into sinners. Pinhead arranges for Christine to kill Sean, and spitefully dispatches Jophiel. As punishment, God banishes Pinhead to Earth, tormented by the want of suffering. In a post-credits scene, a group of Mormon missionaries in Germany approach a house and are answered by The Auditor.

documents.title: Blindsided
documents.overview: Blind man and apple pie connoisseur Walter Cookeventures to his neighborhood corner store to buy milk and apples. When mafia thugs try to shake down the storeowner, Walter shows them what a blind martial artist is capable of!
documents.plot:
Blindsided is an American martial arts action comedy short film directed by Clayton J. Barber and written by Eric Jacobus from a story by Barber, starring Jacobus as a blind fighter. Running about twelve to thirteen minutes, it played the festival circuit before being released in full on YouTube on 1 March 2017. Jacobus, an independent filmmaker, stuntman and performer known for inventive fight choreography in a string of short films and low-budget features, created it as an homage to the blind swordsmen and martial artists of screen history; Screen Anarchy described it as a loving ode to Zatoichi filtered through Jackie Chan. Action film veteran Roger Yuan co-stars and also choreographed the fights, and the cast includes Nicholas Verdi, Brett Sheerin and Khalid Ghajji.

The story is deliberately simple. Walter Cooke (Jacobus) is a blind man and an apple pie connoisseur who needs milk to go with his latest pie, so he heads to his neighbourhood corner store to buy milk and fresh apples. While he is shopping, his friend the shopkeeper, Gordon (Yuan), is confronted by a group of mafia thugs who are shaking him down for money he owes them. The gangsters underestimate the quiet customer, and Walter springs into action, single-handedly taking on the three men and showing them what a blind martial artist is capable of.

The film consists essentially of one extended fight scene. In its early stages Jacobus plays much of the action for comedy, using his cane as a prop in the manner of some of Jackie Chan's best fights, before it escalates into a fast and technically demanding weapons battle of parries, blocks and strikes. Barber's fluid camerawork keeps the geography of the fight clear throughout. During the end credits, footage shows Jacobus training blindfolded to learn how to portray a man without sight convincingly.

The short was warmly received by martial arts and action critics. The Action Elite awarded it full marks, calling it massively entertaining, one of the best short films its reviewer had seen in years, and further proof that Jacobus deserved bigger films, while hoping that Walter would return in a feature. Michael S. Moore of Kiai-Kick gave it 9.5 out of 10 and called it Jacobus's best film yet, praising Barber's direction, Yuan's choreography, the production values and the way the cast packed so much character into a brief running time, his only complaint being that he wanted more.

documents.title: The Bookshop
documents.tagline: A town that lacks a bookshop isn't always a town that wants one
documents.overview: Set in a small English town in 1959, a woman decides, against polite but ruthless local opposition, to open a bookshop, a decision which becomes a political minefield.
documents.plot:
Set in the late 1950s, the film opens with an explanatory voice-over narration. Florence Green has decided to open a bookshop in the small coastal town of Hardborough, Suffolk, where she has lived for years as a war widow. She acquires as her premises the Old House, a damp and abandoned property that has been standing empty for many years.
As Florence is securing a loan from Mr Keble at the bank to open the shop, she is warned that others may have different ideas for the space. She cannot imagine that to be true, as it has been neglected for so long. News of Florence's intentions spread quickly through the small town, and several residents are quick to point out the difficulties Florence may face in opening a shop.
After refurbishing the building and moving in, Florence is invited to a social gathering at the home of Violet Gamart, an influential and ambitious local resident who had privately earmarked the Old House for her own pet project, a local arts centre. Violet makes it clear that it is a project that she has no intention of dropping, in spite of fact that the property is no longer empty.
Aided by several of the townspeople, Mrs Gamart attempts to get Florence evicted, and her shop closed. Rumours spread that Florence has changed her mind and is looking for new premises. When Florence asks Milo North, a local celebrity whom she had met at the party, whether Violet had recruited him for her arts centre project, his response is cagey. Florence's solicitor also talks of the rumours, and supplies her with a list of alternative sites. She rips up the list.
Local fisherman Mr Raven sends along a Sea Scout troop to help install bookshelves. He suggests to Florence that, if the business does well enough for her to need help, she should consider employing Christine, the young daughter of a neighbour. Christine proves very effective, even though she says she does not much like reading.
Florence's best customer is the wealthy bookish recluse Edmund Brundish, who begins to have feelings for Florence as she introduces him to new authors, including Ray Bradbury. Learning of the threats to Florence's business, he emerges from his seclusion, visits Mrs Gamart, and adamantly tells her to desist. The effort involved in doing so is too much for him, and he collapses and dies.
Mrs Gamart's nephew, a member of Parliament, sponsors a bill that empowers local councils to buy any historic building that has been left unused for five years. The bill is passed, the Old House is compulsorily purchased, and Florence is evicted without compensation. Defeated, she departs from the town by ferry, and is waved off from the quayside by Christine. As the boat draws away, she realises that Christine has set the Old House alight with a paraffin heater.
The scene switches to the present day and it becomes clear that the voice-over narrator is the adult Christine, who now runs her own bookshop.

documents.title: Dirty Dancing
documents.tagline: A musical re-imagining
documents.overview: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle, and nothing is ever the same for anyone in the Houseman family.
documents.plot:
Dirty Dancing is a 2017 American musical romantic drama television film directed by Wayne Blair and written by Jessica Sharzer, a remake of the 1987 film of the same name. Abigail Breslin stars as Frances "Baby" Houseman and Colt Prattes as Johnny Castle, with Debra Messing and Bruce Greenwood as Baby's parents, Sarah Hyland as her sister, Lisa, Nicole Scherzinger as the dancer Penny Johnson, and Tony Roberts. It aired on ABC on 24 May 2017.

The film is framed by a scene set in New York in 1975, in which an adult Frances recalls the relationship with Johnny that she never forgot. In the summer of 1963, Baby, an idealistic, college-bound young woman, spends a vacation with her affluent family at Kellerman's, a resort in the Catskill Mountains. There she falls for Johnny, the resort's charismatic working-class dance instructor, and when his dance partner, Penny, becomes unable to perform, Baby secretly learns to dance so she can take her place, defying her father and the social divisions of the resort.

The remake largely follows the original story but makes several changes. Baby now plans to study medicine rather than economics. The role of her mother, Marjorie, is significantly expanded: feeling neglected by her husband, Jake, she considers divorce, before the couple rekindle their romance at the resort where they first met. The character of Vivian Pressman, a lonely divorcee, is also given a larger role, and she is now suspected of planting a watch among Johnny's belongings when he is accused of theft. Lisa rejects the resort's waiter Robbie early on and befriends Marco, a new character who is the resort's African-American pianist, a storyline that touches on the racial attitudes of the era. The film also features new musical numbers performed by the cast alongside songs associated with the original.

The broadcast drew 6.61 million viewers, but the film received mostly negative reviews, with critics comparing it unfavorably with the beloved original, criticizing its pacing and the leads' dancing and chemistry. Scherzinger's performance as Penny was the most widely praised element.

documents.title: No Game No Life: Zero
documents.original_title: ノーゲーム・ノーライフ ゼロ
documents.overview: In ancient Disboard, Riku is an angry, young warrior intent on saving humanity from the warring Exceed, the sixteen sentient species, fighting to establish the "One True God" amongst the Old Deus. In a lawless land, humanity's lack of magic and weak bodies have made them easy targets, leaving them on the brink of extinction. One day, hope returns to humanity when Riku finds a powerful female Ex-machina, whom he names Schwi. Exiled from her Cluster because of her research into human emotions, Schwi is convinced that humanity has only survived due to the power of these feelings. Forming an unlikely partnership in the midst of the overwhelming chaos, Riku and Schwi must now find the answers to their individual shortcomings in each other, and discover for themselves what it truly means to be human as they fight for their lives against all odds. Each with a powerful new ally in tow, it is now up to them to prevent the extinction of the human race and establish peace throughout Disboard!
documents.plot:
In the present, Izuna and Tet play a game of chess on which they have wagered food. As they begin their next game, Tet decides to tell her the story of how the world came to be in its current state.
The tale begins 6,000 years in the past, during the Great War, a worldwide conflict that pitted the sentient races of the world against each other as the Old Deus fought for control of the Suniaster, a conceptual device which would only reveal itself to the strongest being on the planet and make the holder the One True God. To that end, the Old Deus and the other races have effectively destroyed the world, and have driven humankind, the only race unable to use the world's magic, to the brink of extinction. Riku, the leader of humanity's last colony along with his sister Corounne, allows another one of his companions die in a Demonia attack while sourcing for information; the death, along with all the others that have come before, plague him with nightmares and guilt. The colony he leads finds itself on the verge of annihilation, with their leader unstable, their numbers dropping, and the battles that endanger their lives around the area becoming more frequent and drawing ever closer.
Delving into a ruined Elvish hideout the next day to investigate, Riku stumbles upon an Ex-Machina that has been severed from its race's hive-mind for its efforts to understand the human heart, a concept that defies its machine logic and thus could not be calculated by the hive-mind. Initially hesitant to help her, Riku eagerly accepts when she challenges him to a game of chess, despite knowing the frightening processing power the Ex-Machina possess; predictably, he loses, and they agree to cooperate with each other, allowing him to take advantage of her logical prowess and letting her stay with him to learn more about the human heart. Since she has only a long, droning designation code assigned to her, Riku, hearing the word "Schwarzer" (German for "black") in her title, names her Schwi after the color of her hair.
Soon after, Schwi accidentally forces Riku to confront the number of people whose deaths he has caused. While this causes a quarrel between them, it helps her gain a deeper understanding of Riku and helps him face his trauma. Through working together, the two realize that they make an incredible team. They then devise a plan to manipulate the stronger races of the world into fighting and using their strongest weapons against each other; by utilizing the power generated from the spirit circuit of all the races, and using Schwi's machinery to shift its direction. They plan to break into the core of the planet and take the Suniaster for their own.
Riku proposes to Schwi, despite the differences in their races and the latter having previously destroyed the former's last home. When the plan begins to destroy his body, Schwi decides to acquire the Suniaster herself to save his life; in the process, she happens to cross paths with Jibril.

documents.title: My Friend Dahmer
documents.tagline: Jeffrey Dahmer murdered 17 men and boys between 1978 and 1991. This is the story before that story.
documents.overview: Jeffrey Dahmer struggles with a difficult family life as a young boy. During his teenage years he slowly transforms, edging closer to the serial killer he was to become.
documents.plot:
In 1974, Jeffrey Dahmer is a high school freshman living in the unincorporated Cleveland suburb of Bath, Ohio, with his parents, Lionel and Joyce, and his younger brother Dave. Jeffrey develops an obsession with a male jogger he sees every day from his school bus. As a hobby, he collects dead animals that he dissolves to the bone using chemicals from his father, who is a chemist. This hobby is initiated by his obsessive interest in how animals are "fitted together".
In 1978, Lionel trashes Jeffrey's collection of bones and orders him to make friends at school. During school, Jeffrey imitates the speech and gestures of his mother's interior designer (who has cerebral palsy), catching the attention of aspiring artist John "Derf" Backderf and his friends. Jeffrey inspires Derf to draw him in various situations; drawings that would later be incorporated into Derf's graphic novel My Friend Dahmer. Derf and his friends form the "Dahmer Fan Club," using Jeffrey for a variety of pranks (known as “Doing a Dahmer”) such as sneaking him in every yearbook photo, and conning their way to a private meeting with Vice President Walter Mondale during a school field trip to Washington, D.C.
Joyce starts relapsing into chronic mental illness, leading to increasingly bitter fights between her and Lionel. To cope, Jeffrey turns to drinking heavily, and begins killing animals. The jogger with whom he is obsessed turns out to be Dr. Matthews, the physician of one of Derf's friends. Jeffrey fakes a cold so that he can get an appointment with him, and he can examine Jeffrey naked. Dr. Matthews becomes uncomfortable when he notices that Jeffrey has an erection. At home, Jeffrey masturbates to the incident and fantasizes about having sex with Dr. Matthews' corpse. He starts stalking Dr. Matthews with a baseball bat, but never goes through with attacking him.
Jeffrey's father moves out. Jeffrey makes attempts to stay connected to his friends but ultimately drifts away from them. At graduation, Lionel hands Jeffrey the keys to the family Volkswagen Beetle which he would later use to commit his first murder. Unbeknownst to Lionel, Joyce leaves Ohio to live with relatives in Wisconsin, taking Dave with her and leaving Jeffrey completely alone.
That evening, Derf spots Jeffrey walking home with blood on his fingernails. Derf offers him a ride, finding him living alone with no plans for the future. Derf tells him that he is leaving for college and offers him his drawings of Jeffrey, which Jeffrey declines. Jeffrey invites Derf inside for a beer, but he turns him down. As Derf walks back to his car, Jeffrey pretends to strike him with a baseball bat but puts it down. As Derf drives home, he notices the bat. Jeffrey never has contact with his high school friends again.
Two weeks later, Jeffrey picks up hitchhiker Steven Hicks. The closing credits note that Hicks was never seen again and Jeffrey Dahmer admitted to killing 17 men when he was finally arrested in 1991.

documents.title: Fighting with My Family
documents.tagline: A comedy about a family that fights a little differently.
documents.overview: Born into a tight-knit wrestling family, Paige and her brother Zak are ecstatic when they get the once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to try out for the WWE. But when only Paige earns a spot in the competitive training program, she must leave her loved ones behind and face this new cutthroat world alone. Paige's journey pushes her to dig deep and ultimately prove to the world that what makes her different is the very thing that can make her a star.

documents.title: The Darkest Minds
documents.tagline: The ones who changed will change everything
documents.overview: After a disease kills 98% of America's children, the surviving 2% develop superpowers and are placed in internment camps. A 16-year-old girl escapes her camp and joins a group of other teens on the run from the government.
documents.plot:
The Darkest Minds is a 2018 American science fiction thriller film directed by Jennifer Yuh Nelson and written by Alexandra Bracken. The movie is based on the novel of the same name by Alexandra Bracken.

In a dystopian future, the United States government has been ravaged by a mysterious disease that affects children and young adults, causing them to develop supernatural abilities at an alarming rate. These children, known as "orbs," are hunted by the government for their powers, which they use to wreak havoc on society.

The story follows Ruby Daly (Chloe Moretz), a 16-year-old girl who possesses one of the most powerful abilities among her peers. She is taken into custody by the government and sent to a "rehabilitation" camp, where she meets other orbs, including Liam Stenbeck (Auggie Maturo), Chubs (Braxton Brice), and Zu (Harris Dickinson).

At the camp, Ruby discovers that she has been subjected to experimental treatments designed to suppress her powers. However, these treatments have only made her stronger, and she soon escapes from the camp with Liam and a few other orbs.

The group embarks on a perilous journey across the country, pursued by the government's forces, known as "the Division." Along the way, they meet a mysterious figure named Marcus (Patton Oswalt), who claims to be working for a secret organization that seeks to protect orbs from persecution.

As Ruby and her friends navigate their new reality, they begin to uncover the truth about the government's intentions and the origins of the disease. They also discover that Ruby has a unique connection to Liam, which could hold the key to unlocking the secrets of their powers.

Throughout the journey, Ruby struggles with her own identity and the weight of her abilities. She is forced to confront the harsh realities of her world and make difficult choices about who she can trust and how far she is willing to go to protect herself and those she cares about.

Ultimately, Ruby and her friends reach a safe haven, where they hope to find acceptance and protection from the government's forces. However, the movie ends on a cliffhanger, setting the stage for a potential sequel.

The Darkest Minds explores themes of identity, power, and resistance in a world that seeks to control and exploit those with extraordinary abilities. The film features a strong performance from Chloe Moretz as Ruby, who brings depth and nuance to the complex and dynamic protagonist.

documents.title: Acts of Vengeance
documents.tagline: Payback Speaks Louder Than Words
documents.overview: A fast-talking lawyer transforms his body and takes a vow of silence, not to be broken until he finds out who killed his wife and daughter and has his revenge.
documents.plot:
Acts of Vengeance is a 2017 action thriller film directed by Isaac Florentine. Antonio Banderas stars as Frank Valera, a Pittsburgh lawyer seeking revenge for the murder of his wife and daughter, with Karl Urban as the police officer Hank Strode, Paz Vega, Robert Forster, Cristina Serafini and Johnathon Schaech. It was released in theaters and on demand in October 2017.

Frank, a fast-talking, successful defense lawyer, is stuck in traffic and misses his young daughter Olivia's performance at a school talent show, watching only a video of her singing that his wife, Sue, sends him. That night, Sue and Olivia are murdered, and their bodies are dumped near a railway yard. After the funeral, Frank's grieving father-in-law, Chuck, blames him and cuts off contact. At the police station, Detective Bill Lustiger tells Frank that a gold fiber was found at the crime scene and suspects the Russian mafia that operates in the area. Consumed by guilt, Frank seeks punishment by taking beatings in illegal underground fights, until he is rescued by Officer Strode, who later tells him that the case has gone cold.

While trying to help a young girl being exploited on the street, Frank crashes through the window of a bookshop and comes across a copy of the Meditations of the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius. Inspired by the Stoic philosophy, he takes a vow of silence, swearing not to speak again until he has found the killers and avenged his family. Frank devotes himself to intense martial arts training, transforming himself into a disciplined fighter, and begins his own investigation, going after the criminals who operate in the area of the murders. As he follows the trail, he uncovers evidence that the crime was not what the police assumed, and that the truth reaches closer to people he trusted than he had imagined, forcing him to confront corruption and betrayal on his path to vengeance.

Acts of Vengeance received mixed reviews. It holds a 64 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on 11 reviews and a Metacritic score of 49 based on four critics. Reviewers noted Banderas's commitment to the physically demanding role and the efficient fight choreography typical of Florentine, a director known for martial-arts action films, while finding the story familiar.

documents.original_title: Bad Times at the El Royale
documents.tagline: All roads lead here
documents.overview: Lake Tahoe, 1969. Seven strangers, each one with a secret to bury, meet at El Royale, a decadent motel with a dark past. In the course of a fateful night, everyone will have one last shot at redemption.
documents.plot:
Bad Times at the El Royale is a 2018 American neo-noir crime thriller film directed by Drew Goddard and written by Goddard and Alex Kurtzman. The film stars Chris Hemsworth, Emma Stone, Jon Hamm, Jeff Bridges, and Dakota Johnson.

The story takes place on October 1, 1969, at the El Royale Hotel in Lake Tahoe, California/Nevada border. The hotel is a neutral ground for various characters to meet, each with their own secrets and agendas. The film begins with a series of seemingly unrelated events: a young woman named Lila (Dakota Johnson) is found dead in one of the hotel's rooms; a group of thugs attempt to rob the hotel's bar; and a mysterious man named Daniel Flynn (Chris Hemsworth) checks into the hotel.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that each character has a connection to the others. Lila was a prostitute who had been working at the hotel, and her death is linked to a larger conspiracy involving a wealthy businessman named Mark Wahlberg's character, Dwight (Jon Hamm), who is using the hotel as a front for his illicit activities.

Meanwhile, a former CIA operative named Joseph "Daddy" O'Malley (Jeff Bridges) checks into the hotel, seeking revenge against Dwight and his associates. O'Malley has a personal vendetta against Dwight, who he believes is responsible for the death of his daughter.

As the story progresses, it becomes clear that each character has their own motivations and secrets. Lila was being blackmailed by Dwight over her past, while O'Malley's daughter had been murdered by Dwight's associates. The film's plot twists and turns as the characters' stories intersect and collide.

Throughout the film, Goddard pays homage to classic Hollywood films of the 1960s, including the works of Alfred Hitchcock and Billy Wilder. The film's cinematography is also noteworthy, capturing the eerie atmosphere of the El Royale Hotel and its surroundings.

In the end, O'Malley's quest for revenge leads him to confront Dwight in a tense showdown. However, just as it seems that justice will be served, the true extent of Dwight's plan is revealed, and the film ends on a cliffhanger, leaving the audience wondering what will happen next.

Overall, Bad Times at the El Royale is a complex and engaging thriller that explores themes of power, corruption, and redemption. The film features strong performances from its cast, particularly Jeff Bridges and Chris Hemsworth, who bring depth and nuance to their characters.

documents.title: Assassination Nation
documents.tagline: You asked for it, America.
documents.overview: High school senior Lily and her friends, Bex, Em and Sarah live in a haze of texts, posts, selfies and chats just like the rest of the world. So, when an anonymous hacker starts posting details from the private lives of everyone in their small town, the result is absolute madness leaving Lily and her friends questioning whether they'll live through the night.
documents.plot: After an anonymous hacker begins leaking the private data of thousands living in a small American town, the townspeople spiral into madness, with four high school seniors at the center of the maelstrom.

documents.title: Bacurau
documents.tagline: If you come, come in peace
documents.overview: Bacurau, a small town in the Brazilian sertão, mourns the loss of its matriarch, Carmelita, who lived to be 94. Days later, its inhabitants notice that their community has vanished from most maps.
documents.plot:
In the near future, the people of Bacurau, an impoverished, rural settlement in the fictional municipality of Serra Verde, in western Pernambuco, gather for the funeral of Carmelita, an elderly woman seen as the matriarch of the community. Her granddaughter Teresa, now a young woman, returns to town after many years for the occasion, and to deliver some medicine. In the following days, the village experiences a sequence of strange events, including the town inexplicably disappearing from online maps and satellite images, loss of mobile phone signal, sightings of a UFO-shaped drone and an unnamed couple from southern Brazil passing through town on motorcycles.
There is an ongoing dispute over water rights from the local river, with water being dammed upstream in a corrupt scheme masterminded by the wealthy mayor of Serra Verde, Tony Junior. He visits Bacurau in an attempt to secure its residents' votes in an upcoming election with old food and tattered books, but no water; the townspeople all hide to avoid him. A tanker truck of water finally arrives for the town, but it has been riddled with bullets.
When horses stampede through town, two local men are sent to investigate the nearby farm from where they presumably escaped and find the family that owned it murdered. As they attempt to leave the property, they too are murdered, by the southern motorcyclists. This couple then meets again up with a group of mostly American foreigners led by Michael (a German living in the United States for over 40 years). The couple is chastised for killing the two men, as killing them deprived the foreigners of two chances to score "points." After receiving unheard instructions through earpieces, the foreigners kill the couple and then argue over who earned the points for their deaths.
The foreigners begin hunting the townspeople, and Pacote, Teresa's former lover, seeks out Lunga, a revolutionary protecting and being sheltered by the townspeople. Pacote convinces Lunga to join his fight against the foreigners. As the townspeople arm themselves, the foreigners kill a nine-year-old boy and cut off the town's electricity.
The following morning, as the foreigners go hunting, they are gradually overpowered and killed by the locals, with the exception of Michael, who ends up captured. Tony Junior shows up to collect the foreigners in a luxury minibus. When he sees that the townspeople have won, he denies knowing the foreigners until the captured Michael yells to him for help. The mayor is sent away to die in the desert, half-naked and tied up to a donkey, while Michael is buried alive in an underground cell while shouting "this is only the beginning."

documents.title: The Post
documents.tagline: Truth be told
documents.overview: A cover-up that spanned four U.S. Presidents pushed the country's first female newspaper publisher and a hard-driving editor to join an unprecedented battle between journalist and government. Inspired by true events.
documents.plot:
The Post is a 2017 American historical political thriller directed and produced by Steven Spielberg and written by Liz Hannah and Josh Singer. Meryl Streep stars as Katharine Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and Tom Hanks as its executive editor, Ben Bradlee, with Sarah Paulson, Bob Odenkirk, Tracy Letts, Bradley Whitford, Bruce Greenwood, Carrie Coon, Alison Brie and Matthew Rhys. Set in 1971, it depicts the newspaper's struggle to publish the Pentagon Papers, classified documents about the American government's involvement in the Vietnam War.

In 1966, the State Department analyst Daniel Ellsberg accompanies American troops in Vietnam and concludes that the war is unwinnable. Secretary of Defense Robert McNamara privately agrees but publicly continues to justify sending more troops, leaving Ellsberg disillusioned. Later, working at the RAND Corporation, Ellsberg secretly copies thousands of pages of a classified study documenting decades of American involvement in Vietnam, going back to the Truman administration, and leaks them to Neil Sheehan of The New York Times.

In 1971, Katharine Graham has run the Post for eight years, since the suicide of her husband, Phil, who had taken over the paper from her father. Often underestimated by the men around her, she is preparing to take the company public to secure its future, while Bradlee pushes to make the Post a national paper able to compete with the Times. When the Times begins publishing stories based on the leaked study, the Nixon administration obtains a court injunction to stop it. Post editor Ben Bagdikian tracks down Ellsberg and obtains the papers. Bradlee and his reporters race to prepare their own story, but the company's lawyers and board warn that publication could jeopardize the stock offering and expose Graham and Bradlee to criminal prosecution. Graham, torn by her friendship with McNamara and the risk to her family's legacy, must make the decision whether to publish, leading to a battle that reaches the Supreme Court.

The Post received widespread acclaim, with praise for Streep's and Hanks's performances and its timely defense of press freedom. It grossed about $180 million worldwide and received Academy Award nominations for Best Picture and Best Actress for Streep.

documents.title: Life Itself
documents.tagline: Life will surprise you
documents.overview: As a young New York couple goes from college romance to marriage and the birth of their first child, the unexpected twists of their journey create reverberations that echo over continents and through lifetimes.
documents.plot: As a young New York couple goes from college romance to marriage and the birth of their first child, the unexpected twists of their journey create reverberations that echo over continents and through lifetimes.

documents.title: All the Money in the World
documents.original_title: All the Money in the World
documents.tagline: J. Paul Getty had a fortune. Everyone else paid the price.
documents.overview: The story of the kidnapping of 16-year-old John Paul Getty III and the desperate attempt by his devoted mother to convince his billionaire grandfather Jean Paul Getty to pay the ransom.
documents.plot: The story of the kidnapping of 16-year-old John Paul Getty III and the desperate attempt by his devoted mother to convince his billionaire grandfather Jean Paul Getty to pay the ransom.

documents.title: The Girl in the Spider's Web
documents.original_title: The Girl in the Spider's Web
documents.tagline: The past never forgets.
documents.overview: After being enlisted to recover a dangerous computer program, hacker Lisbeth Salander and journalist Mikael Blomkvist find themselves caught in a web of spies, cybercriminals and corrupt government officials.
documents.plot:
The Girl in the Spider's Web is a 2018 action thriller directed by Fede Álvarez, who wrote the screenplay with Jay Basu and Steven Knight, adapted from David Lagercrantz's 2015 novel featuring Stieg Larsson's Millennium characters. A soft reboot and sequel to The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo (2011), it stars Claire Foy as Lisbeth Salander, with Sverrir Gudnason, Lakeith Stanfield, Sylvia Hoeks, Stephen Merchant and Claes Bang.

As girls, Lisbeth and her sister, Camilla, live with their abusive father, crime lord Alexander Zalachenko; when he tries to molest Camilla, Lisbeth escapes by leaping from a balcony, leaving her sister behind. Years later, Lisbeth, now a vigilante hacker in Stockholm, is hired by programmer Frans Balder to steal back Firefall, a program he built for the NSA that can access the world's nuclear codes. She retrieves it but cannot unlock it, and NSA agent Edwin Needham tracks her. Mercenaries led by Jan Holtser steal Firefall and try to kill her. Believing Lisbeth has kept the program, Balder turns to Gabriella Grane, deputy director of the Swedish Security Service, who moves him and his young son, August, to a safe house. Her former lover, journalist Mikael Blomkvist, learns that Holtser once worked for Zalachenko and now serves the Spiders, a crime syndicate. When the safe house is attacked, Holtser kills Balder, frames Lisbeth and abducts August, but Lisbeth rescues the boy, who alone can unlock Firefall, and learns that the Spiders are led by Camilla, whom she believed dead.

Lisbeth frees Needham from custody in return for his promise to take August to his mother in San Francisco. The Spiders trace August and take him to the sisters' childhood home, where Camilla kills Grane, who had hired them. Lisbeth and Blomkvist are captured, and Lisbeth tells August to reveal the password, but Needham, guided by her hacker friend Plague, shoots Camilla's men through the walls with a sniper rifle. Camilla flees with the laptop, and Holtser, blinded by poison, is killed by her car. On a clifftop Camilla asks why Lisbeth never came back for her, then steps off the edge. Needham finds that Lisbeth has destroyed Firefall, August is reunited with his mother, and Lisbeth destroys her childhood home.

Released by Sony after premiering at the Rome Film Festival in October 2018, the film grossed $35 million against a $43 million budget. Critics found it a less complex, action-focused reboot, giving it 38% on Rotten Tomatoes and 43 on Metacritic.

documents.title: Max 2: White House Hero
documents.tagline: Man's best friend is the country's biggest hero.
documents.overview: Max is assigned to the White House while Butch, the secret service dog, is on maternity leave. He meets TJ, a 12 year old boy, who is the President's son. Due to his father's high profile, he is trying hard to fit in and lead a normal life. During a state visit by the Russian President and his daughter, Alexandra (Alex), TJ is asked to accompany her, during their stay. TJ befriends Alex, but when they get into trouble, Max comes to the rescue!
documents.plot:
Max 2: White House Hero is a 2017 American family adventure film directed by Brian Levant, a sequel to the 2015 film Max. It features the same heroic military dog, played by the dogs Carlos, Jagger and Dude, but none of the first film's human characters. Zane Austin stars as T.J. Bennett, with Lochlyn Munro as President Thomas Bennett, Francesca Capaldi as Alexandra "Alex" Bragov, Andrew Kavadas as the Russian president Vladimir Bragov, Carrie Genzel as the First Lady, Reese Alexander as Secret Service Agent Thorn, Bradley Stryker as Chef Coop and Kathryn Kirkpatrick as Olga.

Max is assigned to the White House to fill in while the resident Secret Service dog is on maternity leave, and he quickly bonds with T.J., the president's twelve-year-old son, who is struggling to lead a normal life in the bubble created by his father's position. When the Russian president arrives for negotiations on a nuclear arms treaty, bringing his daughter Alex, T.J. is asked to keep her company. The two become friends, and when they sneak out of the White House in search of a party thrown by T.J.'s new classmates, masked men try to kidnap them. Max, who has followed them, fends off the attackers, and the children escape into trouble with their parents.

Convinced that someone wants the talks to fail, T.J. and Alex start investigating everyone they suspect, but their sleuthing keeps backfiring. After further danger, including an attempt to harm the First Lady that Max narrowly foils, the Secret Service persuades the president to take Max off duty, and the angry Russian leader prepares to cut his visit short. Unable to sleep, T.J. discovers that Coop, the White House chef, is a Russian mole, and is locked in a freezer while Olga lures Alex into the woods to be abducted. Max breaks out of his cage to free T.J., and a chase involving both presidents and Agent Thorn ends with the culprits captured and Alex rescued. The fathers resume their talks and reach a historic agreement, Max is honoured for bravery, and the resident dog's three puppies await T.J.

Filmed in and around Vancouver, British Columbia, in June and July 2016, the film was released in May 2017 and came to DVD and Blu-ray from Warner Bros. Home Entertainment on May 23. Common Sense Media called it a conventional, harmless and forgettable story kept moving by its engaging young leads and the dog's exploits, and Forbes concluded that it was simply meant for kids, who could do better but also much worse.

documents.title: Trolls World Tour
documents.tagline: Happiest. Movie. Ever.
documents.overview: Queen Poppy and Branch make a surprising discovery — there are other Troll worlds beyond their own, and their distinct differences create big clashes between these various tribes. When a mysterious threat puts all of the Trolls across the land in danger, Poppy, Branch, and their band of friends must embark on an epic quest to create harmony among the feuding Trolls to unite them against certain doom.
documents.plot:
Trolls World Tour is a 2020 musical comedy film directed by Mike Mitchell and written by Aaron Seltzer, Scott Mosier, and Jennifer Peña. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2016 animated film Trolls.

The story begins with Poppy (voiced by Anna Kendrick), the optimistic leader of the Trolls, who is preparing for the annual "Trollstice" celebration. However, their festivities are disrupted when Queen Barb (voiced by Rachel Bloom), the ruler of the hard rock trolls, threatens to destroy all other music genres and rule over a world where only hard rock music exists.

Barb's plan is to steal the magical song that gives each genre its unique sound, which she believes will make her the most powerful troll in the land. Poppy teams up with Branch (voiced by Justin Timberlake), her grumpy but lovable companion, to stop Barb and save all the other music genres.

Their journey takes them to different parts of the world, where they meet various musical groups from different genres, including country, jazz, classical, and hip-hop. Along the way, Poppy and Branch encounter new friends, such as Prince D (voiced by Anderson .Paak), a smooth-talking prince who joins their quest.

As they travel through these different worlds, the Trolls learn about the unique characteristics of each genre and how music brings people together. However, Barb's plan is to use the magical song to dominate all other genres and rule over the world.

The movie features an impressive array of musical numbers, showcasing a wide range of genres and styles. The film's soundtrack includes original songs by various artists, such as Anderson .Paak, Sia, and Charli XCX.

In the end, Poppy and Branch successfully stop Barb from stealing the magical song, and all the music genres come together to celebrate their differences and unity. The movie concludes with a grand musical number featuring all the Trolls and their new friends, celebrating the power of music to bring people together.

Overall, Trolls World Tour is a fun and colorful film that celebrates the diversity of music and the importance of embracing our individuality. While it may not be as strong as its predecessor, the movie still delivers plenty of laughs, catchy musical numbers, and heartwarming moments.

documents.title: Smallfoot
documents.tagline: There's been a big myth-understanding
documents.overview: A bright young yeti finds something he thought didn't exist—a human. News of this “smallfoot” throws the simple yeti community into an uproar over what else might be out there in the big world beyond their snowy village.
documents.plot:
Smallfoot is a 2018 American computer-animated comedy-adventure film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and New Line Cinema. The movie follows the story of Migo, a Yeti who lives in the frozen wilderness of North Pole.

The film begins with Migo (voiced by Channing Tatum) living a peaceful life among his fellow Yetis, who believe that humans are mythical creatures that exist only in stories. However, Migo is fascinated by human artifacts and has discovered a human foot in the ice. He decides to embark on a journey to find out if humans really do exist.

Migo's search leads him to a group of humans living in the city of New York, where he meets a kind-hearted explorer named Meechee (voiced by Gina Rodriguez). Meechee is an anthropologist who has been studying Yetis and their culture. She helps Migo understand human behavior and language.

As Migo spends more time with Meechee, he begins to question his own identity and the stories told by his fellow Yetis. He starts to see humans as real individuals rather than just mythical creatures. However, not everyone is happy about Migo's newfound friendship with a human. A rival Yeti named King Waternoose (voiced by James Corden) seeks to exploit Migo's discovery for his own gain.

King Waternoose and his followers believe that the existence of humans will lead to the downfall of the Yetis' way of life. They plan to capture Meechee and use her as a pawn in their game. Migo must now protect Meechee and find a way to convince his fellow Yetis that humans are real.

As the story unfolds, Migo learns more about human culture and values. He also discovers that humans have been watching him and his fellow Yetis from afar. The film features stunning animation and humor, with plenty of comedic moments.

In the end, Migo's friendship with Meechee helps to change the way the Yetis perceive humans. They begin to see humans as individuals rather than just mythical creatures. King Waternoose is defeated, and Migo returns home a hero. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Migo and his fellow Yetis embracing their newfound understanding of humans.

Overall, Smallfoot is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and acceptance. With its stunning animation and lovable characters, it's a must-see for families and fans of animated movies.

documents.title: Red Nose Day Actually
documents.tagline: Love Continues
documents.overview: Fourteen years after the events of the first film, a series of encounters between people in Britain reminds us that in these different times Love, actually exists.
documents.plot:
The film is set in March 2017, 13 years after the events of the original film.
Juliet is watching television with her husband Peter. When the doorbell rings and she opens the door, Juliet finds Mark, who, similarly to 13 years ago, communicates with her by using cue cards, having her pretend to Peter, this time, that Mark is a fund raiser for Red Nose Day. They tell each other that they are very happy with their respective lives, and Mark presents his new wife, who is none other than British supermodel Kate Moss, whom, 13 years prior, he jokingly said he was going to marry. Mark's final card proposes that they see what happened to the rest of their friends.
David, who has lost and recently regained his position as Prime Minister since the first film, dances in his official residence once again (this time to Hotline Bling, as opposed to Jump (For My Love) in the original), even continuing in great pain after falling down the stairs. His wife and former employee Natalie amicably reprimands him, and offers to make him tea. Later in a public speech, he states that although times are harder for a lot of people now, he still believes that love and the good in people will win in the end.
Billy Mack recently released a charity single, a cover of the 1983 ZZ Top song "Gimme All Your Lovin'". As the reporter interviewing him on radio tries to help him raise awareness for Red Nose Day, Billy openly admits to not caring about children (except for the ones that buy his discs) and that he only promotes the charity to, in truth, get free publicity for his upcoming autobiography, which he has admittedly neither written nor read. He then reveals with sadness that his manager Joe has died from a heart attack since the first film, before stating that the greatest sex he ever had was with one of the Kardashians, although he cannot decide which one.
Among salesman Rufus's products are red noses in honour of Red Nose Day. When a child in line buys one and agrees to have it gift wrapped, Rufus proceeds with great delight to take an absurdly excessive amount of time doing so. The waiting line soon becomes so long that it blocks car traffic outside.
Meanwhile, on their way to pick up their three children from school, Jamie and his wife Aurélia recall their first days together. Aurélia says in Portuguese that even though life makes it impossible to be completely happy, love sometimes makes you feel like you are. She then reveals to Jamie that she is pregnant with their fourth child, though he misunderstands her and believes she was telling him what was for dinner.
Sitting on a bench near the Thames, Daniel receives a surprise visit from his stepson Sam, who is now 26 and lives in New York City, New York, USA. When Daniel expresses concern because Sam had not been in touch, he is surprised to see Joanna, Sam's childhood crush 13 years ago who had left for US. She asks for Sam's hand in marriage, and Daniel, delighted, jokingly answers that he will think about it.

documents.title: Skyscraper
documents.tagline: Don't look down
documents.overview: Framed and on the run, a former FBI agent must save his family from a blazing fire in the world's tallest building.
documents.plot:
Skyscraper is a 2018 action thriller film directed by Rawson Marshall Thurber and produced by Legendary Pictures. The movie stars Dwayne Johnson, Neve Campbell, and Roland Møller.

The story begins with Will Sawyer (Dwayne Johnson), a former FBI agent who lost his family in a fire at their home when he was just a child. This traumatic event led to Will's estrangement from his father, Gary Sawyer (Ronny Cox), a renowned architect who designed the world's tallest skyscraper, the Centennial Tower.

Years later, Will is hired by the CEO of the Centennial Tower, Hendricks (Patrick Wilson), to investigate the building after it has been severely damaged in a fire. However, upon arrival, Will discovers that the fire was no accident and that his father had designed the tower with a secret escape route for him, which he had never revealed.

As Will delves deeper into the mystery, he realizes that Hendricks is behind the fire and plans to use the building's advanced technology to gain control over the city's infrastructure. The CEO intends to sell the building to a foreign government, but his plan is threatened by Will's investigation.

Will soon finds himself trapped in the burning tower with his father, who has been hiding secrets about the building's design. Together, they must navigate the treacherous skyscraper and outsmart Hendricks' henchmen to prevent the sale of the building to the foreign government.

As the story unfolds, Will's personal demons are revealed, including his complicated relationship with his father and his feelings of guilt over not being able to save his family. The action-packed plot is filled with suspenseful moments, heart-pumping stunts, and intense hand-to-hand combat sequences.

Throughout the movie, Will's character undergoes significant development as he confronts his past and learns to forgive himself and his father. The film's climax features an epic showdown between Will and Hendricks, with the fate of the city hanging in the balance.

Ultimately, Will emerges victorious, having saved the day and restored his family's legacy. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, with Will finally finding closure and redemption after years of struggling to come to terms with his past.

Overall, Skyscraper is an action-packed thrill ride that combines stunning visuals, heart-pumping stunts, and a gripping storyline. Dwayne Johnson delivers a memorable performance as the protagonist, bringing depth and nuance to the character's emotional journey.

documents.title: The Little Mermaid
documents.tagline: Be a part of her world.
documents.overview: The youngest of King Triton’s daughters, and the most defiant, Ariel longs to find out more about the world beyond the sea, and while visiting the surface, falls for the dashing Prince Eric. With mermaids forbidden to interact with humans, Ariel makes a deal with the evil sea witch, Ursula, which gives her a chance to experience life on land, but ultimately places her life – and her father’s crown – in jeopardy.
documents.plot:
The Little Mermaid is an American musical fantasy film of 2023, Disney's live-action remake of its animated film of 1989, which was loosely based on Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale. Directed by Rob Marshall from a screenplay by David Magee, it stars Halle Bailey as the mermaid Ariel and Jonah Hauer-King as Prince Eric, with Melissa McCarthy as the sea witch Ursula, Javier Bardem as King Triton, Noma Dumezweni as Queen Selina, Art Malik as Grimsby and the voices of Daveed Diggs as Sebastian, Jacob Tremblay as Flounder and Awkwafina as Scuttle.

In the undersea kingdom of Atlantica, in the Caribbean, Ariel collects human objects in a secret grotto, though her father Triton forbids merfolk to visit the surface because a human killed her mother. One night she swims up to watch fireworks from a ship carrying Eric, prince of a nearby island. When a storm wrecks the ship, she saves him, brings him to shore and sings to him, vanishing before he fully wakes. Learning from the crab Sebastian that she rescued a human, Triton smashes her collection. Ursula, Triton's banished sister, then offers Ariel a deal: three days as a human in exchange for her voice. If she wins true love's kiss she stays human; if not, she returns to the sea and her soul belongs to Ursula.

Found on the shore and taken to the palace, Ariel bonds with Eric, who has been seeking the girl who saved him, over his collection of treasures from his travels, and they tour the island together. Sebastian discovers that Ursula's spell makes Ariel forget she needs the kiss, and he, Flounder and Scuttle nearly bring the couple together before Ursula's eels intervene. Ursula then takes human form as Vanessa and uses Ariel's voice to bewitch Eric, who announces their engagement. Alerted by Scuttle, Ariel breaks the shell holding her voice, freeing Eric, but the sun sets before they can kiss. To save his daughter, Triton gives himself up to Ursula, who seizes his trident, grows to enormous size and raises a storm and sunken ships. Ariel steers a wreck to impale her on its broken bowsprit, Triton is restored, and he transforms Ariel into a human so she can be with Eric, the couple setting off on travels together with both families' blessing.

Released in May 2023, the film grossed $569.6 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed to positive, with 67% on Rotten Tomatoes, and Bailey was widely praised.

documents.title: A Quiet Place
documents.tagline: If they hear you, they hunt you.
documents.overview: A family is forced to live in silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound.
documents.plot:
A Quiet Place is a 2018 American horror-thriller film directed by John Krasinski, who also co-wrote the screenplay with Bryan Woods and Scott Beck. The film stars Emily Blunt, John Krasinski, Millicent Simmonds, and Noah Jupe.

The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where creatures that hunt by sound have wiped out much of humanity. The film follows the Abbott family - Lee (John Krasinski), Evelyn (Emily Blunt), and their children Regan (Millicent Simmonds) and Marcus (Noah Jupe) - who live in a rural area, trying to survive in silence.

The creatures, which are blind but have an acute sense of hearing, can detect even the slightest sound. The family must navigate their daily lives without making any noise, using sign language and creative methods to communicate with each other. They also use a system of taps on the wall to signal danger or important events.

The story begins with Evelyn giving birth to Regan in a hospital, where she is forced to make a difficult decision to save her baby's life by sacrificing her own hearing. The family then moves to their rural home, where they try to live in silence and avoid attracting the creatures' attention.

As the story progresses, the family faces various challenges, including a neighbor who becomes infected with the creatures after being attacked, and Evelyn's growing concern about Regan's ability to communicate with her family without making noise. The tension builds as the family tries to protect themselves from the creatures, while also dealing with their own personal struggles.

One of the most striking aspects of the film is its use of sound design, which creates a sense of unease and tension throughout. The creatures' movements are often accompanied by eerie sounds, such as rustling leaves or snapping twigs, which make it impossible for the audience to look away.

The climax of the film takes place in an abandoned church, where Evelyn and Regan must navigate through the darkness to find a way out. Along the way, they encounter the creatures, who are attracted by Regan's tapping on the wall. The scene is intense and suspenseful, with the audience holding its breath as Evelyn tries to protect her daughter.

In the end, Evelyn manages to save Regan, but not without great personal cost. The film ends with a sense of hope and renewal, as Evelyn and Regan begin to rebuild their lives in silence.

Overall, A Quiet Place is a masterclass in tension and suspense, with a unique premise that is both terrifying and thought-provoking. The film's use of sound design and its exploration of themes such as family and sacrifice make it a standout in the horror genre.

documents.title: Life in a Year
documents.overview: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.
documents.plot:
Life in a Year is a 2020 American romantic drama film directed by Mitja Okorn from a screenplay by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. It stars Jaden Smith as Daryn and Cara Delevingne as Isabelle, with Cuba Gooding Jr. and Nia Long as Daryn's parents, Xavier and Catherine, and RZA, Chris D'Elia, Stony Blyden and JT Neal in supporting roles. Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith served as executive producers through their Overbrook Entertainment banner. Shot in Toronto beginning in April 2017, the film was released in the United States on Amazon Prime Video by Sony Pictures Releasing on November 27, 2020.

Daryn is a high school student whose demanding father, Xavier, has convinced him that his only goal in life should be getting into Harvard. One night, while trying to sneak into a rapper's concert, he meets a girl named Isabelle and is immediately drawn to her. He courts her and falls in love, but when he confesses his feelings, Isabelle reveals that she has cancer and does not have much time left. Determined to make the most of it, Daryn resolves to fit a whole life into a single year. Isabelle, in turn, recognizes his talent as a rapper and helps him record his first demo. When Daryn introduces her to his parents, Xavier treats her as a distraction from his son's future and interrogates her coldly, and Isabelle leaves, offended, with Phil, the drag queen who has acted as a parent to her. At his Harvard interview, Daryn realizes that everything he has achieved has been for his father rather than himself, and he walks out, setting off a bitter confrontation at home. Choosing Isabelle over his family's expectations, Daryn leaves town with her. Together they try to reconnect Isabelle with the mother who abandoned her, and they face the progression of her illness, as Daryn learns what it means to love someone with so little time, and both search for a way to give their short time together the meaning of a lifetime.

Casting was announced in 2017, beginning with Delevingne and Smith in March. Terrence Howard was originally cast as Daryn's father, but Gooding Jr. replaced him in May 2017, when D'Elia also joined the cast. The film's release came more than three years after principal photography had taken place.

documents.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Volume 3
documents.tagline: It's time to face the music.
documents.overview: After acquiring Knowhere from the Collector, we find the Guardians working to repair the extreme damage done by Thanos-determined to make Knowhere a safe haven, not only for themselves, but for all refugees displaced by the harsh universe. It isn't long before their attempt to return to normal is upended by a brutal attack from a new unknown enemy, and Peter, still reeling from the loss of Gamora, must rally his team around him to defend the universe along with protecting one of their own. A mission, if not completed successfully, could quite possibly lead to the end of the Guardians as we know them.
documents.plot:
Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, promoted under the title Guardians of the Galaxy Volume 3, is an American superhero film of 2023 written and directed by James Gunn. It is the 32nd Marvel Cinematic Universe film. Chris Pratt returns as Peter Quill, with Zoe Saldaña as Gamora, Dave Bautista as Drax, Karen Gillan as Nebula, Pom Klementieff as Mantis, Vin Diesel as Groot, Bradley Cooper as Rocket, Will Poulter as Adam Warlock and Chukwudi Iwuji as the High Evolutionary.

At their new base on Knowhere, the Guardians are attacked by Adam Warlock, a warrior created by the Sovereign's High Priestess Ayesha. Nebula drives him off, but Rocket is gravely wounded, and the team's medical kits cannot save him because of a kill switch implanted by the company Orgocorp. They set off to find the override code. As Rocket lies near death, he remembers his origins: as a baby raccoon he was experimented on by Orgocorp's leader, the High Evolutionary, who sought to engineer animals into beings for an ideal society on Counter-Earth. His brilliance enraged his creator, who planned to harvest his brain and destroy his fellow subjects, the otter Lylla, the walrus Teefs and the rabbit Floor. Rocket's rescue attempt failed; his friends were killed and he escaped alone.

Helped by an alternate Gamora, now one of the Ravagers, the team raids Orgocorp and learns that the code was removed by the High Evolutionary's adviser Theel. Pursued by Ayesha and Adam, they travel to Counter-Earth, which the High Evolutionary bombards when he deems it imperfect, killing its inhabitants and Ayesha. Quill and Groot kill Theel and recover the code, and as Rocket flatlines and sees his lost friends, Lylla tells him it is not his time and Quill restarts his heart. Drax, Nebula and Mantis are captured aboard the High Evolutionary's ship, where they find genetically altered children. The Guardians fight their way through his forces and evacuate the children and imprisoned animals. Rocket spares the defeated High Evolutionary, and Adam, earlier saved by Groot, rescues Quill. Afterward Quill leaves the team, naming Rocket captain, and returns to his grandfather on Earth; Mantis sets off on her own, Gamora rejoins the Ravagers, and Drax and Nebula stay to raise the children as a new line-up of Guardians forms.

Released in May 2023, the film grossed $845.6 million worldwide. Critics found it a heartfelt send-off for the team, giving it 82% on Rotten Tomatoes.

documents.title: X-Men: The Mutant Watch
documents.overview: While Senator Kelly addresses a senate committee about the supposed mutant menace, we learn about the making of the movie, X-Men.
documents.plot:
X-Men: The Mutant Watch is a 2000 American promotional television special made to publicize Bryan Singer's superhero film X-Men, produced by 20th Century Fox, with Marvel Entertainment credited. It aired on the Fox network on 11 July 2000 in a half-hour evening slot, the day before the film's premiere at Ellis Island and three days before its release in the United States on 14 July. Running just under 22 minutes, it combines a fictional framing story with making-of material, and features Hugh Jackman, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Anna Paquin, Famke Janssen, Singer and the comics creator Stan Lee, with Bruce Davison reprising his film role as Senator Robert Kelly and Patti Yasutake as a fellow senator.

Rather than presenting itself as a conventional behind-the-scenes program, the special stages its information as an in-universe event. In newly shot footage, Senator Kelly, the McCarthy-like anti-mutant politician of the film, who claims to hold a list of mutants living in the United States and campaigns for a Mutant Registration Act that would force mutants to reveal their identities and abilities, addresses a Senate committee about what he describes as the growing mutant menace, while a colleague challenges his position. Intercut with the hearing, viewers learn about the making of the film through clips from the movie, rapid-fire interview excerpts with members of the cast and crew, and short glimpses behind the scenes of the production, among them the application of Rebecca Romijn-Stamos's elaborate makeup as the shape-shifting Mystique.

The special was later included as a bonus feature on some home video releases of X-Men, including Fox's DVD released on 21 November 2000, alongside an extended branching version of the film, excerpts from Charlie Rose's interview with Singer, Jackman's screen test and animatics. DVD Movie Guide described it as a glossy, promotional infomercial with a mildly clever framework, noting that its behind-the-scenes segments were brief and concluding that anyone seeking solid information about the creation of the film would have to look elsewhere.

documents.title: Pokémon Detective Pikachu
documents.tagline: Partner Up!
documents.overview: In a world where people collect pocket-size monsters (Pokémon) to do battle, a boy comes across an intelligent monster who seeks to be a detective.
documents.plot:
Pokémon Detective Pikachu is a live-action/animated mystery film directed by Rob Letterman, based on the popular Pokémon franchise. The movie follows the story of Tim Goodman (played by Justice Smith), a young man who sets out to find his missing father, Billy Goodman (played by Ken Leung).

The story begins with Tim's father going missing in Ryme City, a fictionalized version of New York City. Tim is initially skeptical about his father's disappearance, but after receiving a mysterious letter from him, he becomes determined to uncover the truth.

Upon arriving in Ryme City, Tim meets Detective Pikachu (voiced by Ryan Reynolds), a talking Pikachu who claims to be a detective. Initially, Tim is hesitant to trust Pikachu, but as they begin their investigation together, he starts to realize that his father's disappearance may be more complex than he initially thought.

As they delve deeper into the case, Tim and Pikachu encounter various characters, including Ryme City's mayor (played by Suki Waterhouse) and a group of rogue Pokémon trainers. Along the way, Tim discovers that his father was involved in a conspiracy to uncover a plot to capture and exploit rare Pokémon.

Throughout their investigation, Tim and Pikachu face numerous challenges and obstacles, including battling against Team Rocket, a group of nefarious Pokémon trainers who seek to exploit the city's Pokémon population for their own gain. Along the way, Tim also learns more about his father's past and the reasons behind his disappearance.

As the story unfolds, Tim and Pikachu uncover a shocking truth: Billy Goodman was working with a mysterious organization known as Team Flare, which seeks to capture and exploit rare Pokémon for their own purposes. The team is led by Giovanni (played by Sam Rockwell), a charismatic but ruthless leader who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals.

In the climactic final act, Tim and Pikachu face off against Team Flare in an epic battle to save Ryme City's Pokémon population. With the help of Detective Pikachu, Tim is able to uncover the truth behind his father's disappearance and bring down Team Flare.

The movie concludes with Tim finally finding closure and a new sense of purpose, thanks to his adventures with Detective Pikachu. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Tim and Pikachu parting ways but remaining connected by their shared experiences and newfound friendship.

Overall, Pokémon Detective Pikachu is an action-packed adventure that combines humor, heart, and excitement, bringing the beloved Pokémon franchise to life in a unique and thrilling way.

documents.title: Kickboxer: Retaliation
documents.tagline: It's time to fight back
documents.overview: One year after the events of "Kickboxer: Vengeance", Kurt Sloan has vowed never to return to Thailand. However, while gearing up for a MMA title shot, he finds himself sedated and forced back into Thailand, this time in prison. He is there because the ones responsible want him to face a 6'8" 400 lbs. beast named Mongkut and in return for the fight, Kurt will get two million dollars and his freedom back. Kurt at first refuses, in which a bounty is placed on his head as a way to force him to face Mongkut. Kurt soon learns he will have no other choice and will undergo his most rigorous training yet under some unexpected mentors in order to face Mongkut in hopes to regain his freedom.
