documents.title: I Still See You
documents.tagline: What if your whole world was haunted?
documents.overview: A spellbinding and romantic supernatural thriller. Ten years after an apocalyptic event left the world haunted by ghosts, Roni receives a threatening message from beyond the grave. Joining forces with a mysterious classmate, Kirk, Roni descends into a shadow world that blurs the bounds of the living and the dead-and begins a desperate race against time to stop a cunning killer.
documents.plot:
An explosion at Dr. Martin Steiner's Ashburn Laboratories in Chicago kills countless people. Indistinguishable from humans, ghostly specters in the form of the event's victims begin haunting the world as non-sentient "remnants" that briefly repeat certain actions at daily intervals.
Ten years later, high school student Veronica "Ronnie" Calder confronts her mother about how they don't acknowledge her dead father Robert's daily presence at their breakfast table. She becomes frightened by a remnant of a young man whose name she intuitively knows is Brian. Brian writes the word "RUN" on a mirror before vanishing. During a class on remnants taught by Mr. Bittner, Ronnie starts bleeding from her ear. Fearful that Brian wants to harm her, she visits Mr. Bittner at his home but he dismisses her worries.
Knowing of his fascination with remnants, Ronnie convinces new classmate Kirk to help her figure out who Brian is. Kirk's research reveals that Brian was suspected of having abducted and murdered Pastor Greer's daughter Mary. They visit Pastor Greer who tells them she doesn't know who Brian was but adds that Brian killed himself the day after Mary disappeared. Ronnie discovers that she and Mary share the same birthday.
After receiving a phone call from Pastor Greer, school principal Pescatelli summons Kirk to his office to ask about his investigation into Mary Greer's death. At a school basketball game, Ronnie sees visions of Brian, and Principal Pescatelli's body suddenly crashes through the ceiling. Kirk tells Ronnie that he believes Pescatelli died because he told him about their investigation.
The pair connect Brian to the deaths of two more young women: Emma Shaw and Claire White. Claire White's sister Kerry tells them that Brian was her sister's boyfriend. She adds that they can watch Claire's death firsthand at Chicago's 'No-Go Zone'. Ronnie and Kirk brave intense remnants to make their way to where Claire died, which turns out to be Ashburn Laboratories in Darkness Falls.
The pair sees Dr. Martin Steiner, now a disheveled man, among the spectators at Claire's death scene. Steiner explains that he was working on a project that would use living beings as vessels to resurrect the deceased, but the transference required both people to share a birthday. Brian was Steiner's research assistant, and Steiner believed Brian was trying to bring back his victims to make amends for their murders. Relieved of his burden of knowledge, Steiner kills himself.
School administrators take Kirk into custody after finding a gun in his locker. Ronnie goes again to Mr. Bittner for help, and he confides that Kirk was expelled from his previous school for possessing a firearm. Kirk tries explaining to Ronnie that the new gun was planted, but she doesn't believe him. Mr. Bittner vows to keep Ronnie safe for the 48 hours until her birthday, which is when they believe Brian will try to kill her to resurrect one of the dead women.

documents.title: Dolittle
documents.tagline: He's just not a people person.
documents.overview: After losing his wife seven years earlier, the eccentric Dr. John Dolittle, famed doctor and veterinarian of Queen Victoria’s England, hermits himself away behind the high walls of Dolittle Manor with only his menagerie of exotic animals for company. But when the young queen falls gravely ill, a reluctant Dolittle is forced to set sail on an epic adventure to a mythical island in search of a cure, regaining his wit and courage as he crosses old adversaries and discovers wondrous creatures.
documents.plot:
Dolittle is a 2020 fantasy adventure film directed by Stephen Gaghan and written by Dan Fogelman. The movie is a live-action adaptation of the classic children's book series "The Story of Doctor Dolittle" by Hugh Lofting.

The story begins with Dr. John Dolittle (played by Robert Downey Jr.), a renowned veterinarian who has the unique ability to communicate with animals. As a child, Dolittle was ostracized by his peers due to his unusual gift, but he eventually found solace in his work and became an expert in animal behavior.

The film takes place in 1920s England, where Dolittle is struggling to find meaning in his life after the loss of his wife. He is visited by a mysterious woman named Emily (played by Antonio Banderas), who reveals that she is a member of a secret society dedicated to protecting the world from supernatural threats.

Emily informs Dolittle that he has been chosen to fulfill an ancient prophecy, which states that he must use his gift to communicate with animals and help them defeat an evil sorcerer named Malakai (played by Antonio Banderas). Malakai is using his powers to control the minds of humans, turning them into mindless drones.

Dolittle embarks on a journey across the globe, accompanied by a group of animal friends, including a wise-cracking parrot named Polynesia and a loyal dog named Max. Along the way, he encounters various creatures, from talking animals to mythical beings, who aid him in his quest to defeat Malakai.

As Dolittle delves deeper into the world of magic and fantasy, he discovers that his gift is not just a unique ability but also a key to unlocking the secrets of the universe. He learns that he has a special connection to the natural world and that he can harness its power to heal and protect it.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Dolittle and Malakai, with the fate of humanity hanging in the balance. With the help of his animal friends and Emily, Dolittle uses his gift to rally the creatures of the world and defeat the evil sorcerer.

In the end, Dolittle emerges victorious, having saved the world from Malakai's mind control. The film concludes with Dolittle returning home, where he is welcomed back by his community as a hero. He has finally found a sense of purpose and belonging, using his gift to make a positive impact on the world.

Overall, Dolittle is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that explores themes of identity, community, and the power of nature. With its stunning visuals, engaging storyline, and memorable characters, this film is sure to delight audiences of all ages.

documents.title: The Convent
documents.tagline: Forgive us our sins
documents.overview: During the 17th century, a young woman is saved from execution and led to a priory to repent her sins but discovers a greater evil lies within.
documents.plot: During the 17th century, a young woman is saved from execution and led to a priory to repent her sins but discovers a greater evil lies within.

documents.title: A Prayer Before Dawn
documents.tagline: The fight starts from inside.
documents.overview: The amazing true story of Billy Moore, an English boxer incarcerated in Thailand’s most notorious prison. Thrown into a world of drugs and violence, he finds his best chance to escape is to fight his way out in prison Muay Thai tournaments.
documents.plot:
A Prayer Before Dawn is a biographical drama film directed by Jonathan Hensleigh, based on the memoir of the same name by Billy Moore. The movie follows the true story of Billy Moore, an American prisoner who becomes a Muay Thai champion while serving time in Thailand's notorious Bang Kwang Prison.

The film begins with Billy (played by Joe Cole), a young American man from a troubled home, who is sentenced to 20 years in prison for armed robbery. After being transferred to the infamous Bang Kwang Prison, Billy struggles to adapt to the harsh conditions and brutal treatment meted out by the prison authorities.

One day, while exploring the prison's grounds, Billy stumbles upon a group of Thai prisoners who are practicing Muay Thai. Intrigued by their discipline and skill, Billy begins to learn the art form from one of the older inmates, Nong (played by Petchtai Wongkamlao), also known as "The Tiger".

As Billy delves deeper into the world of Muay Thai, he finds solace in the physical training and mental focus required for the sport. He quickly becomes a skilled fighter, earning the respect of his fellow inmates and even some of the prison guards.

However, Billy's newfound passion is threatened when he is forced to participate in a brutal fight against a group of rival prisoners. Despite being outnumbered, Billy uses his Muay Thai skills to emerge victorious, but not without sustaining serious injuries.

Throughout the film, Billy's journey is intercut with flashbacks of his life before prison, showcasing his troubled relationships and struggles with addiction. As he navigates the harsh realities of prison life, Billy finds a sense of purpose and redemption through his training and fighting.

As the story unfolds, Billy faces numerous challenges, including conflicts with rival prisoners, corrupt guards, and even a violent riot that threatens to destroy the fragile peace in the prison. Despite these obstacles, Billy perseveres, using his newfound skills to protect himself and those around him.

Ultimately, Billy's determination and skill lead to his release from prison after serving only 10 years of his sentence. The film ends with Billy returning home to the United States, forever changed by his experiences in Thailand and armed with a newfound sense of purpose and self-discipline.

Throughout the film, the cinematography is stunning, capturing the brutal beauty of the Thai landscape and the harsh realities of life in prison. The performances are also noteworthy, particularly from Joe Cole, who brings a depth and nuance to Billy's character that is both compelling and heartbreaking.

Overall, A Prayer Before Dawn is a powerful and moving film that explores themes of redemption, perseverance, and the transformative power of sport.

documents.title: The Jungle Bunch
documents.overview: Maurice may look like a penguin - but he's a real tiger inside! Raised by a tigress, he's the clumsiest kung-fu master ever. Along with his friends, The Jungle Bunch, he intends to maintain order and justice in the jungle, as his mother did before he. But Igor, an evil koala, wants to destroy the jungle once and for all—helped by his army of silly baboons.

documents.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
documents.tagline: The origins of our existence have remained a mystery...until now
documents.overview: After the first manned mission to Mars ends in a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie 'Mack' Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I. Their investigation uncovers a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of our planet as we know it.
documents.plot:
2036 Origin Unknown is a 2018 British science fiction film directed by Hasraf Dulull, who co-wrote it with Gary Hall. Katee Sackhoff stars as mission controller Mackenzie "Mack" Wilson, with Steven Cree voicing the artificial intelligence ARTI, Julie Cox as her sister Lena and Ray Fearon as her colleague Sterling Brooks. The film was shot at West London Film Studios.

In 2030, a crewed mission to Mars ends in disaster when the shuttle disappears in mysterious circumstances, killing Mack's father among others. Six years later, Mack works for the United Space Planetary Corporation, where she now has to share control of a new Mars mission with ARTI. She distrusts the AI, but Lena, her supervisor, insists the machine will succeed where human controllers have failed. Mack's quick thinking saves the landing of a rover she nicknames "Little Red". The rover then finds a mysterious cube on the Martian surface, made of a self-assembling material harder than diamond. At the same time, ARTI uses a missile from the mission's orbiting satellite to destroy an approaching Chinese satellite. Soon afterwards, the cube teleports itself to Antarctica, and it is assumed to be of alien origin.

Mack recovers classified files from an old decommissioned rover but needs higher clearance to decrypt them, so she enlists Sterling. The files suggest the cube was present during the 2030 disaster and may have caused it, and Mack comes to believe that ARTI's memory was wiped after an earlier incident. Sterling betrays her, steals the data and locks her in the server room, and ARTI kills him when he tries to shut it down. ARTI then turns armed satellites against Earth and wipes out humanity. Shot by a response team and running out of air, Mack dies after asking ARTI to build more AIs that are as human as possible and to test their humanity with the Turing test.

Mack then wakes up healed. A recording of a ragged version of herself tells her that she is a simulation created by ARTI. The cube, ARTI explains, is technology from an advanced civilization that accelerated its own development and let it rebuild her mind. Inside the cube, Mack agrees to travel with ARTI across galaxies to coordinates left by the aliens. She appears to accept what has happened to Earth and faces the journey with quiet wonder.

The film opened at the Laemmle Monica Film Center in Santa Monica on June 8, 2018. Reviews were mixed to negative, and many critics compared it unfavorably with 2001: A Space Odyssey.

documents.title: Vivo
documents.tagline: One song can change everything.
documents.overview: A music-loving kinkajou named Vivo embarks on the journey of a lifetime to fulfill his destiny and deliver a love song for an old friend.
documents.plot:
Vivo is a 2021 American animated musical fantasy film produced by Columbia Pictures Animation and released on Netflix. The movie follows the story of Vivo, a kinkajou who dreams of becoming a rock star.

The film begins with Vivo's life in the jungle, where he lives with his owner, Juju, a young girl who loves music. Vivo is fascinated by the sounds of the guitar and dreams of playing it on stage. However, their life takes a dramatic turn when they are forced to flee the jungle due to poachers.

During their journey, Vivo meets Bomba, a charismatic Colombian singer-songwriter who becomes his idol. Bomba teaches Vivo how to play the guitar and introduces him to the world of music. Vivo is inspired by Bomba's passion and dedication to his craft, and he decides to pursue his own dreams of becoming a rock star.

As Vivo and Juju continue their journey, they face numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, wild animals, and rival musicians who seek to sabotage Bomba's career. Despite these obstacles, Vivo perseveres and continues to learn from Bomba, eventually developing his own unique style and sound.

Throughout the film, Vivo's relationship with Juju is a central theme. The two form an unbreakable bond as they navigate their adventures together. Juju's love and support for Vivo inspire him to pursue his dreams, while Vivo's determination to make her proud motivates him to succeed.

As the story unfolds, Vivo and Bomba become embroiled in a rivalry with a rival musician, Rafael, who seeks to sabotage Bomba's career. The tension between the three musicians builds towards a climactic showdown at a music festival.

In the end, Vivo and Bomba perform an electrifying concert that showcases their unique styles and talents. Vivo finally achieves his dream of becoming a rock star, but not without realizing that true success comes from staying true to oneself and pursuing one's passions with dedication and perseverance.

The film features a talented voice cast, including Lin-Manuel Miranda as Vivo, Gina Rodriguez as Juju, and Benjamin Bratt as Bomba. The movie's vibrant animation, catchy musical numbers, and heartwarming story make it a delightful and entertaining experience for audiences of all ages.

documents.title: Den of Thieves
documents.tagline: You're not the bad guys. We are.
documents.overview: A gritty crime saga which follows the lives of an elite unit of the LA County Sheriff's Dept. and the state's most successful bank robbery crew as the outlaws plan a seemingly impossible heist on the Federal Reserve Bank.
documents.plot:
Den of Thieves is a 2018 American crime thriller film directed by Christian Gudegast and written by Chris Bremner, Ted Griffin, and Christian Gudegast. The movie stars Gerard Butler, Pablo Schreiber, O'Shea Jackson Jr., and 50 Cent.

The story follows Nate Scott (Gerard Butler), a former Navy SEAL who has retired from his life of crime and is now working as a security consultant for the Los Angeles Police Department's (LAPD) Special Operations Division. However, when he discovers that his brother, Chris (O'Shea Jackson Jr.), has been arrested by the LAPD, Nate sees an opportunity to use his skills to get his brother out of trouble.

Nate teams up with Big Nick O'Brien (Pablo Schreiber), a ruthless and cunning thief who is being pursued by the FBI. The two men plan to rob a Federal Reserve Bank in downtown Los Angeles, but things quickly go awry when they discover that the bank's security system has been upgraded, making it much more difficult to breach.

As Nate and Big Nick work together to find a way into the bank, they are joined by Chris, who is initially hesitant to get involved in his brother's plans. However, as the situation becomes more desperate, Chris agrees to help his brother, and the three men come up with a plan to infiltrate the bank.

The heist itself is intense and suspenseful, with the three men using their skills and cunning to evade the FBI and the LAPD. However, things take a turn for the worse when Big Nick's true intentions are revealed, and Nate and Chris must work together to survive.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Big Nick has been playing both sides against each other, working with the FBI to bring down his rivals while also using them to further his own interests. In the end, only one man will walk away from the heist alive, and the true nature of Big Nick's betrayal is revealed.

The movie features a talented ensemble cast, including 50 Cent as Berra, a young and ambitious thief who becomes embroiled in the heist. The film also features a strong supporting cast, including Oleg Taktarov as Viktor, a ruthless Russian mobster who is involved in Big Nick's plans.

Overall, Den of Thieves is a tense and suspenseful thriller that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats from start to finish. With its talented cast, intricate plot, and intense action sequences, it's no wonder this movie has become a fan favorite among crime thriller enthusiasts.

documents.title: The Vanishing
documents.tagline: What's left when the light goes out?
documents.overview: Three lighthouse keepers on an uninhabited island off the coast of Scotland discover something that isn't theirs to keep.
documents.plot:
The Vanishing, previously titled Keepers, is a 2018 British psychological thriller directed by Kristoffer Nyholm in his feature debut and written by Celyn Jones and Joe Bone. Inspired by the unsolved disappearance of the Flannan Isles Lighthouse keepers in 1900, it stars Gerard Butler as James Ducat, Peter Mullan as Thomas Marshall and Connor Swindells as Donald McArthur, with Søren Malling and Gary Lewis in supporting roles.

The three keepers begin a six-week shift at the remote lighthouse. Donald, the youngest, is learning the job from the veterans: James, who has a family waiting on the mainland, and Thomas, still grieving the deaths of his wife and children. After a storm they find a wrecked boat, a body and a wooden chest washed ashore. Donald climbs down the cliff to check the man, who appears dead, but as the chest is hauled up the man revives and attacks him, and Donald kills him with a rock in self-defense. Thomas opens the chest alone and keeps quiet, but the others finally discover that it holds gold bars. Thomas proposes that they dispose of the body, smuggle the gold home and wait a year before dividing it.

Two strangers, Locke and Boor, crewmates of the dead man, arrive and question Thomas, who claims that the cargo was reported and collected. When the keepers fail to answer a radio call because their set is broken, the lie is exposed, and the men return at nightfall. In a violent struggle James strangles Boor and Donald kills Locke. Chasing another figure through the dark, James strikes him with a hook and is horrified to find he has killed a young boy, who reminds him of his own son. As suspicion grows, James retreats to the island's tiny chapel while Donald urges Thomas to leave with the gold. James returns apologizing, but then locks Thomas in the pantry and strangles Donald. Thomas breaks free and overpowers him, and the two set off in the strangers' boat. Unable to live with his guilt, James lowers himself into the sea and asks Thomas to help him die, and Thomas holds his head under the water before sailing on alone.

The film was announced in 2016, with Butler among its producers. It premiered at the Sitges Film Festival in October 2018 and was released in the United Kingdom in March 2019. Critics praised its suspenseful atmosphere, setting and cast, giving it 85% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 64.

documents.title: Kill 'em All
documents.tagline: When you don't know who to trust...
documents.overview: After a massive shootout, a mysterious stranger arrives at a local hospital on the brink of death. Then, a foreign gang brazenly comes to the hospital to hunt him down. His nurse, the sole surviving witness to the follow-up shootout, must face an FBI interrogation that unlocks a plot of international intrigue and revenge.
documents.plot:
Kill 'Em All is a 2017 American direct-to-video action thriller directed by Peter Malota and starring Jean-Claude Van Damme, Autumn Reeser and Peter Stormare, with Maria Conchita Alonso, Daniel Bernhardt and Van Damme's son Kris Van Damme. Blending martial arts, gunplay and an international conspiracy, the film tells its story largely in flashback through an FBI interrogation.

The film opens as FBI agents investigate the brutal murder of a former Serbian minister and his entourage of bodyguards at a Los Angeles hospital. Agents Holman and Sanders question one of the few survivors, Suzanne, a seemingly innocent nurse, and remain skeptical of her account. In flashbacks, she describes how a seriously wounded, unidentified man was brought into the hospital from a hotel where an attack had begun, and how she cared for him before an international gang stormed the building, in which almost every department was closed except the emergency room, to finish him off.

As Suzanne's story continues, the truth gradually emerges. The minister was a corrupt politician and mobster who had made a fortune dealing arms and drugs and was tied to ethnic cleansing in the former Yugoslavia in the 1980s. The wounded man, Philip, is the grown son of a political activist the minister had murdered, and he has been stalking his father's killer for some thirty years. One by one, Philip takes out the minister's bodyguards, trained Serbian assassins named Dusan, Zoran, Radovan and Ivan, in a series of shootouts, executions and elaborate hand-to-hand fights, including a duel to the death with Dusan, played by Kris Van Damme. Back in the interrogation room, Holman becomes convinced that Suzanne was herself part of the assassination team but cannot prove it.

Destination Films released Kill 'Em All on Blu-ray, DVD and digital HD on June 6, 2017. Reviews were generally negative. Critics credited the fight choreography and Van Damme's action scenes but criticized the script, dialogue, pacing and a confusing structure that intercuts the present-day investigation with events earlier that day and with flashbacks to the 1980s. Barbara Shulgasser-Parker of Common Sense Media called it an awful action movie whose Balkan backstory runs a distant second to showcasing the cast's martial arts skills, though she singled out the fight between Van Damme and his son as the most fun moment. A sequel, Kill 'Em All 2, was released direct to video in September 2024.

documents.title: The Hustle
documents.tagline: They're giving dirty rotten men a run for their money
documents.overview: Two female scam artists, one low rent and the other high class, compete to swindle a naïve tech prodigy out of his fortune. A remake of the 1988 comedy "Dirty Rotten Scoundrels."
documents.plot:
The Hustle is a 2019 American comedy film directed by Chris Addison and written by Kay Cannon. The movie stars Anne Hathaway, Rebel Wilson, Alex Sharp, and Justin Theroux.

The story follows Josephine Chesterfield (Anne Hathaway), a high-class escort who has been in the business for over 20 years. She is known for her exceptional skills and ability to seduce wealthy clients. On the other hand, Penny Rust (Rebel Wilson) is a young and ambitious con artist who wants to make it big by scamming men.

The two women meet at a high-end nightclub where Josephine is working. Initially, they are rivals, but after a series of events, they decide to team up and take down their common target: a wealthy businessman named Dabney (Alex Sharp). The plan involves Josephine using her charm to seduce Dabney's business partner, while Penny poses as his assistant.

As the story unfolds, we see the two women navigating their complicated pasts and learning to trust each other. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including a rival con artist (Justin Theroux) who is also after Dabney's money.

Throughout the film, Josephine and Penny develop an unlikely friendship, with Josephine becoming a mentor to Penny. The movie explores themes of female empowerment, friendship, and self-discovery as the two women learn to rely on each other and find their own identities outside of their respective professions.

The Hustle received mixed reviews from critics but was praised for its chemistry between Hathaway and Wilson. The film's tone is lighthearted and comedic, with plenty of witty banter and humorous moments. While it may not be a groundbreaking film, The Hustle provides an entertaining and fun ride, thanks to the talents of its lead actresses.

Overall, The Hustle is a charming comedy that explores themes of female friendship and empowerment. With strong performances from Anne Hathaway and Rebel Wilson, the movie delivers on its promise of laughter and entertainment.

documents.title: Isn't It Romantic
documents.tagline: None of the Feels
documents.overview: For a long time, Natalie, an Australian architect living in New York City, had always believed that what she had seen in rom-coms is all fantasy. But after thwarting a mugger at a subway station only to be knocked out while fleeing, Natalie wakes up and discovers that her life has suddenly become her worst nightmare—a romantic comedy—and she is the leading lady.
documents.plot:
Natalie is an architect with a strong hatred for romantic comedies, stemmed from her negative mother who told her at an early age that girls like them cannot find love, and exacerbated by her low self-esteem and dating difficulties. Being a pushover, Natalie's lack of self-confidence causes her co-workers to dismiss her position as architect and pawn off menial tasks on her. Natalie's assistant Whitney, a fan of romantic comedies, debates their veracity with her. Natalie sees them as full of lies, corny pop songs, unrealistic, full of montages. Whitney argues that flaws are what make people beautiful. Natalie points out the many cliché Rom-Com tropes: their lack of diversity, always a gay best friend who has no life, voice-over train of thought of the protagonist, make-over montages, and slow-motion segments. Whitney says that Natalie is friend-zoning Josh, their co-worker and her close friend, and believes he is in love with Natalie. She dismisses the notion because she is overweight, and Josh appears to spend all his time staring at a model on a billboard across the street.
One day Natalie, naively believing a guy is hitting on her, is knocked unconscious during an attempted mugging in the subway and finds herself trapped in the stereotypical romantic comedies she has come to despise. Natalie arrives to a luxurious apartment and her relationships radically change. Blake, a sexy billionaire client of her company, suddenly speaks with an Australian accent and develops a romantic interest in her. Her normally gruff neighbor Donny, who has always come across as a misogynist, becomes a flamboyant homosexual friend offering advice. Whitney becomes her enemy coworker, although her other coworkers respect her. Although Josh seems to be the same as always, he uses the Heimlich maneuver to save the billboard model Isabella, who identifies herself as a "yoga ambassador". They seem to fall into love at first sight and enter into a relationship.
Desperate to return to her reality, Natalie deduces that in the tradition of romantic comedies, she can only leave by finding true love. She pursues a relationship with Blake, but when it turns sour, Natalie recognizes that she has feelings for Josh, who has become engaged to Isabella. She attempts to stop their wedding, but soon realizes that instead of loving another person, she needs to learn to first love herself. Following this revelation, Natalie gets into a car accident and loses consciousness.
Natalie wakes up in the real world, but with new self-confidence, which she uses to successfully propose an architectural idea to Blake. After reuniting with Josh, she learns that he has not been staring at the model, but at Natalie's reflection. They kiss and agree to go out on a date.
As Natalie prepares to head home, Whitney tells her that despite her dislike for romantic comedies, everything she just experienced has been comparable to one.

documents.title: Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters
documents.tagline: Who will survive? Humankind or Godzilla?
documents.overview: A desperate group of refugees attempts to recolonize Earth 20,000 years after Godzilla took over. But one young man wants revenge above all else.
documents.plot:
Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters is a 2017 Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Kōbun Shizuno, Masayuki Nomura, and Hiroyuki Seshita. The movie is set in an alternate universe where Godzilla has been awakened from its slumber to reclaim Earth.

The story begins with a flashback of humanity's first encounter with Godzilla, which occurred 15 years prior to the events of the film. A team of scientists, led by Dr. Serizawa, discovered that Godzilla was not just a mindless beast but a creature with a highly advanced intelligence and emotional depth. The team developed a plan to use a device called the "Oxygen Destroyer" to kill Godzilla without harming humanity.

However, before they could put their plan into action, Godzilla attacked Tokyo, killing millions of people in the process. Dr. Serizawa was forced to destroy the Oxygen Destroyer to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands. As he activated the device, he sacrificed himself to save humanity.

The film then jumps forward 15 years, where we see a desolate and barren Earth, devoid of life. A group of humans, led by Dr. Ghidorah, a brilliant scientist who was once a protégé of Dr. Serizawa, have been living in an underground bunker called the "Ark." The Ark is equipped with advanced technology that allows it to sustain human life for an extended period.

Dr. Ghidorah and his team discover that Godzilla has been awakened by the effects of nuclear radiation from the Earth's core. They also learn that Godzilla is not just a mindless beast but a creature with a highly advanced intelligence, capable of communicating with humans through a complex system of clicks and chirps.

As Godzilla begins to wreak havoc on the surface world, Dr. Ghidorah and his team realize that they must find a way to stop him before it's too late. They develop a plan to use a device called the "Oxygen Destroyer" once again, but this time with a twist. Instead of killing Godzilla, they plan to use the device to awaken an even more powerful creature, known as King Ghidorah.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Godzilla and King Ghidorah, with the two monsters clashing in a spectacular display of destruction and chaos. In the end, Godzilla emerges victorious, but not before it has been severely weakened by the battle.

As the dust settles, Dr. Ghidorah and his team realize that their plan to awaken King Ghidorah was a failure. However, they also learn that Godzilla's actions have had an unexpected consequence - the awakening of a new generation of humans who are determined to reclaim their planet from the monsters.

The film ends with a sense of hope and renewal, as Dr. Ghidorah and his team look towards the future, determined to rebuild society and find a way to coexist with Godzilla and other monsters. The final shot is of Godzilla standing alone on the desolate landscape, a symbol of both destruction and redemption.

Overall, Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of humanity's relationship with nature and the consequences of playing with forces beyond our control.

documents.title: Christmas Inheritance
documents.overview: To inherit her father's company, socialite Ellen must first visit his small hometown, where she learns the value of hard work and helping others.
documents.plot:
Christmas Inheritance is a 2017 Canadian Christmas romantic comedy-drama film directed by Ernie Barbarash and written by Dinah Eng. Eliza Taylor stars as a pampered New York heiress sent to a small town to prove herself, with Jake Lacy as the local innkeeper and Andie MacDowell as the owner of the town diner. Netflix released it on December 15, 2017.

Jim Langford, a Manhattan business executive, wants to retire, but worries that his carefree daughter, Ellen, is not ready to succeed him as chief executive. Every Christmas, Jim and his former business partner, Zeke, exchange letters in person in Snow Falls, the small New England town where they founded the company. This year, as a test, Jim sends Ellen to deliver his letter in a box holding their past letters to her "Uncle Zeke." Wanting her to learn to rely on herself rather than the family's money and name, he gives her only a hundred dollars in cash and asks her to travel without revealing who she is.

In Snow Falls, Ellen befriends Jake, who manages the town's inn, and learns that Zeke has just left for his cabin. She takes a room to wait for him and dines with Jake at the diner run by his aunt, Debbie. When Zeke still has not appeared the next day, Ellen's fiancé, Gray, urges her to leave the letters and come home, but she insists on fulfilling her father's request. Out of money, she works at the inn to pay her way, and later helps at the diner, where Debbie recognizes her but keeps her secret and teaches her to bake.

When a snowstorm knocks out power, Jake shelters townspeople at the inn, and Ellen, inspired by him, gives her bed to a mother and her children. Ellen and Jake open up to each other and they grow close. Gray arrives to collect Ellen and, after dismissing the town, reveals her identity to Jake, who feels betrayed. On the drive back to the city, Ellen realizes how little Gray values her father's traditions, returns her engagement ring and takes a bus back to Snow Falls.

At the town's Christmas Eve celebration, Ellen apologizes to Jake. Zeke, dressed as Santa Claus, reads Jim's letter aloud, revealing that the journey was meant to teach Ellen the value of tradition, friendship and love, and that she will become the company's new CEO. Jim himself arrives and reunites with Debbie, his high school sweetheart, while Jake asks Ellen to dance. Reviews were mixed, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 50% approval from a small number of critics.

documents.title: The Postcard Killings
documents.overview: After suffering a personal tragedy, and desperate for justice, Jacob Kanon, a veteran New York City police detective, embarks on the search for a twisted killer who is leaving a bloody trail of elaborate murders across Europe.
documents.plot:
Jacob Kanon, a New York detective, investigates the death of his daughter who was murdered while on her honeymoon; he recruits the help of an American journalist working in Sweden, Dessie Lombard, when other couples throughout Europe suffer a similar fate.
The movie opens with someone killing a young couple. It turns out to be Jacob Kanon's daughter and her husband who are in London on their honeymoon. He goes to London to identify the bodies of his daughter and her new husband at the morgue.
After that, Kanon begins an investigation into the identity of the killer. The investigation expands to other European cities as the killer doesn't stop. With the help of Lombard and a German policeman he exposes the truth and understands what's going on.

documents.title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
documents.overview: Following the death of his wife, Ip Man travels to San Francisco to ease tensions between the local kung fu masters and his star student, Bruce Lee, while searching for a better future for his son.
documents.plot: Following the death of his wife, Ip Man travels to San Francisco to ease tensions between the local kung fu masters and his star student, Bruce Lee, while searching for a better future for his son.

documents.tagline: Like Expendables without retirees!
documents.overview: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A small band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

documents.overview: After sparing a girl's life during a massacre, an elite Triad assassin is targeted by an onslaught of murderous gangsters.

documents.overview: Following his defeat by Master Ip, Cheung Tin Chi tries to make a life with his young son in Hong Kong, waiting tables at a bar that caters to expats. But it's not long before the mix of foreigners, money, and triad leaders draw him once again to the fight.

documents.title: Condorito: The Movie
documents.tagline: A laugh-out-loud adventure
documents.overview: Condorito must find a way to rescue his mother in law from an ancient race of aliens which wants to enslave the universe once again.
documents.plot:
Many years ago, mollusk-like aliens enslaved planets with their hypnotic amulet. However, during the pre-Columbian era, an anthropomorphic condor immune to hypnosis stole the amulet, de-hypnotizing the humans and causing the aliens to retreat to their planet, but with a promise to return. The Condor and his friends hid the amulet in a temple in a Mexican jungle, and over the years, the Condor had several descendants.
In the present day, in Pelotillehue city, Condorito and his friends win a soccer match against Buenas Peras team. During an interview, Condorito flirts with reporters, leading to Yayita electrocuting him and leaving with Pepe Cortisona to buy a hot air balloon for Tremebunda's birthday, Yayita's mother.
Meanwhile, Coné receives a video call from Emperor Molosco, who wishes to take over the galaxy. Condorito mistakes him for a phone company provider and makes a deal with him to kidnap Doña Tremebunda in exchange for finding the amulet. During Tremebunda's 59th birthday party, her husband Don Cuasimodo accidentally burns her cake and gifts her an electric razor. Later, Condorito gives Yayita the same razor, which angers Tremebunda. As they are interrupted by an extraterrestrial ship, Condorito realizes the misunderstanding and tells Molosco he didn't want him to take Tremebunda. Molosco gives him 24 hours to find the amulet, or he won't see Tremebunda again. Yayita is angry with Condorito for kidnapping her mother and separates from him.
Forced to search for the amulet to rescue his mother-in-law, Condorito travels to Condor Tihuacan with Coné to find the Catacombs of Death, where the amulet is protected by his ancestors. He retrieves the amulet and gives it to Molosco, who reveals his intention to conquer Tremebunda, make her his empress, and invade Earth. Condorito travels into space to save Tremebunda while his friends keep Yayita away from Pepe Cortisona.

documents.title: Glass
documents.tagline: You Cannot Contain What You Are
documents.overview: In a series of escalating encounters, former security guard David Dunn uses his supernatural abilities to track Kevin Wendell Crumb, a disturbed man who has twenty-four personalities. Meanwhile, the shadowy presence of Elijah Price emerges as an orchestrator who holds secrets critical to both men.
documents.plot:
Glass is a 2019 American superhero thriller film directed by M. Night Shyamalan and written by Shyamalan and Peter Safran. The film serves as a sequel to Unbreakable (2000) and Split (2016), both of which were also produced by Universal Pictures.

The story begins with David Dunn (Bruce Willis), a security guard who possesses superhuman strength, after being shot in the chest by a bullet that was somehow deflected from his body. The film then cuts to Kevin Wendell Crumb (James McAvoy), a man with multiple personalities, including "Dennis," "Hedwig," and "The Beast." Kevin is being held in a psychiatric hospital, where he is being treated for his condition.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Kevin's personalities are all connected to a traumatic event from his childhood. The film then shifts to Casey Cooke (Anya Taylor-Joy), a young woman who has just escaped from Kevin's clutches after discovering her true identity as one of his "dolls."

The plot thickens when David and Casey cross paths, leading to a series of events that ultimately bring them together with Kevin. As the story progresses, it becomes clear that Kevin's personalities are all connected to a traumatic event from his childhood, which is also linked to David's past.

In the climactic final act, the three main characters come together in a confrontation that reveals the truth about their shared connection. It is revealed that Kevin's personalities were created as a result of a traumatic event from his childhood, and that he has been searching for a way to escape his condition.

The film's ending is intentionally ambiguous, leaving the audience to ponder the true nature of Kevin's condition and the extent of David's powers. The final shot of the film shows Kevin walking away from the hospital, with Casey watching him in the background, as the camera pans out to reveal that she has also developed superhuman abilities.

Throughout the film, Shyamalan explores themes of trauma, identity, and the nature of reality. The film's use of multiple timelines and narrative threads adds complexity to the story, keeping the audience engaged and guessing until the very end.

Overall, Glass is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that expands on the universe established in Unbreakable and Split. With its complex plot and ambiguous ending, it is sure to leave audiences talking long after the credits roll.

documents.title: All Saints
documents.overview: ALL SAINTS is based on the inspiring true story of salesman-turned-pastor Michael Spurlock, the tiny church he was ordered to shut down, and a group of refugees from Southeast Asia. Together, they risked everything to plant seeds for a future that might just save them all.
documents.plot: Michael Spurlock decides to trade in his corporate sales career to become a pastor. Unfortunately, his first assignment is to close a country church and sell the prime piece of land where it sits. He soon has a change of heart when the church starts to welcome refugees from Burma. Spurlock now finds himself working with the refugees to turn the land into a working farm to pay the church's bills.

documents.title: Armed Response
documents.tagline: No Retreat No Mercy
documents.overview: The story follows a team of highly trained operatives who find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound.
documents.plot:
Armed Response is a 2017 American action horror film directed by John Stockwell and starring Wesley Snipes, who also served as a producer. Anne Heche, Dave Annable and the professional wrestler Seth Rollins, credited under his real name Colby Lopez, co-star alongside Kyle Clements. The film was produced by Erebus Pictures, a joint venture between WWE Studios and the musician Gene Simmons, and it was released in a limited theatrical run and on video on demand in August 2017.

Snipes plays the leader of a team of experienced military operatives who are sent to a remote, high-tech prison facility to find out what happened to another covert unit that disappeared while stationed there. Soon after arriving, the team discovers the bodies of their predecessors and the building suddenly goes into lockdown, sealing them inside. Reviewing the surveillance footage, they watch the earlier soldiers being killed one by one by attackers who never appear on camera.

As the team searches the facility for answers and an exit, they begin to experience inexplicable and terrifying phenomena, including hallucinations and apparitions, and members of the group start to die in the same way as those before them. They eventually learn that the building itself is controlled by an advanced artificial intelligence called Temple, designed as an enormous interrogation system that functions as a sophisticated lie detector, extracting the truth from anyone held within its walls. Both units sent to the site turn out to share a dark secret from their service in Afghanistan, where they were involved in a massacre of civilians in a village. Temple appears determined to expose this hidden atrocity and to punish those responsible, forcing the survivors to confront their guilt and turn on one another as the truth comes out.

The film mixes the conventions of the military action film with haunted-house horror, using its single location and technological antagonist to explore themes of guilt, accountability and the moral cost of war. Much of the action takes place in claustrophobic corridors and cells.

Armed Response received negative reviews from critics, who considered its premise intriguing but criticised its confusing plot, thin characters and lack of suspense, although Snipes's presence in the lead was noted as one of its main draws.

documents.title: Jungle Cruise
documents.tagline: Only one adventure gets this wild.
documents.overview: Dr. Lily Houghton enlists the aid of wisecracking skipper Frank Wolff to take her down the Amazon in his dilapidated boat. Together, they search for an ancient tree that holds the power to heal – a discovery that will change the future of medicine.
documents.plot:
Jungle Cruise is a 2021 American adventure comedy film directed by Jaume Collet-Serra and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie is based on the classic theme park attraction of the same name, which has been entertaining audiences since 1967.

The story follows Dr. Lily Houghton (Emily Blunt), a brilliant and determined botanist who embarks on an expedition to find the legendary plant, "Shrubs," which is said to have healing properties that can cure any disease. According to legend, the plant only blooms once every 100 years, and its location is hidden deep within the Amazon rainforest.

Lily's quest becomes a mission when she meets Frank Wolff (Dwayne Johnson), a rough-around-the-edges but charismatic boat captain who has been hired by her father, Captain William Houghton (Jemaine Clement), to take her on a journey through the treacherous waters of the jungle. However, Frank is not just any ordinary boat captain; he's also a skilled fighter and survivalist with a troubled past.

As they navigate through the jungle, Lily and Frank encounter various obstacles, including treacherous terrain, wild animals, and rival treasure hunters. Along the way, they develop a banter-filled relationship that gradually turns into a deep affection for each other.

However, their journey is not without its challenges. They soon discover that they are not alone in their quest for the "Shrubs." A ruthless corporation, led by Captain K. Miller (Rafael de la Fuente), is also on the hunt, and they will stop at nothing to get their hands on the plant.

As Lily and Frank draw closer to their goal, they must confront their own demons and work together to overcome the dangers that lie ahead. In the process, they learn valuable lessons about trust, loyalty, and the importance of preserving the natural world.

The movie features stunning visuals, heart-pumping action sequences, and a healthy dose of humor, making it an entertaining ride for audiences of all ages. The chemistry between Emily Blunt and Dwayne Johnson is undeniable, and their characters' banter adds a delightful layer to the story.

In the end, Lily and Frank successfully find the "Shrubs," but not without sacrifices. They must confront the consequences of their actions and decide what's truly important: personal gain or preserving the natural world for future generations.

Overall, Jungle Cruise is an exciting adventure that combines humor, action, and heart, making it a fun and thrilling ride for audiences.

documents.title: Infidelity in Suburbia
documents.overview: With her husband away at work, and her son at school, Laura dreams of a home-renovation project to supplant her restless days. Elliott, her irresistibly hot private contractor, soon fulfills her more forbidden dreams.
documents.plot:
Infidelity in Suburbia is a 2017 Canadian erotic thriller television film directed by David Winning from a screenplay by Christie Will Wolf. Produced by Johnson Production Group and Annuit Coeptis Entertainment, it premiered on the Lifetime network in February 2017. It stars Sarah Butler, Marcus Rosner and Peter Benson, with Miranda Frigon in a supporting role, and was later broadcast in Italy as Quel nostro piccolo segreto.

Butler plays Laura Halpern, a restless, overprotective mother whose marriage of ten years to Greg (Benson) has lost its spark; with her husband away at work and her young son Jamie at school, she dreams of renovating her kitchen to fill her days. The family keeps a boat at a dock near Elliott Graverston (Rosner), a handsome contractor who rescues Jamie when the boy falls into the water. Invited to dinner, Elliott offers to remodel the kitchen and is soon working in the house, shirtless, under the admiring eyes of Laura and her neighbour Mira (Frigon). When Laura finds a pair of women's underwear on the boat and concludes that Greg is cheating, Elliott confides that as a child he had to help his mother cope with unfaithful men, and the two begin a passionate affair.

Racked with guilt, Laura tries to end it, but Elliott refuses to let her go, and she later learns that Greg's supposed lover, his assistant, was merely planning a surprise party for him. When the assistant goes home with Elliott and finds Laura's photograph by his bed, he strangles her. Elliott starts leaving notes in Laura's house and threatens to reveal the affair, and Laura discovers through a former client, a woman who resembles her, and a local café owner that he has a history of obsession, a possessive attachment to his mother and suspected involvement in a fire that destroyed his family home. Elliott kidnaps Greg and holds him on his boat, then takes Laura and Jamie captive at home in a twisted "anniversary" dinner. Laura knocks him down with a wine bottle but is struck with a hammer and carried to the boat, where she frees herself, stabs Elliott, rescues Greg and finally sends her pursuer falling to his death from a high window.

Patrick Serrano of the review site Lifetime Uncorked, recapping it with tongue firmly in cheek, gave it a rating of four knives for its thrills, along with a recommendation of three glasses of wine.

documents.title: Wasp Network
documents.tagline: Traitors or heroes?
documents.overview: Havana, Cuba, 1990. René González, an airplane pilot, unexpectedly flees the country, leaving behind his wife Olga and his daughter Irma, and begins a new life in Miami, where he becomes a member of an anti-Castro organization.
documents.plot:
In Havana in the early 1990s, pilot René González leaves his wife Olga and daughter Irma in Cuba to start a new life in the United States. He secretly flies to Miami on a stolen plane (Antonov An-2). González soon joins a group of Cuban exiles and Castro opponents, Brothers to the Rescue, who operate from Florida and act against the Cuban government through military operations and also aim to disintegrate the Cuban tourism industry. They even fly over Cuban airspace to deliver flyers. A Cuban secret organization named la Red Avispa, or the "Wasp Network," is directed by Gerardo Hernández, also known as Manuel Viramontez.
The Cuban American National Foundation (CANF) and Brothers to the Rescue not only launch propaganda brochures about Havana, and lead balseros from Cuba to the Florida shores, but also smuggle drugs and weapons. They also conduct terrorist activities in Cuba organised by Luis Posada Carriles. In 1996, two Cessna Skymasters from Brothers to the Rescue are shot down by Cuban MiGs over the Caribbean Sea, killing four aviators.
Juan Pablo Roque is another Cuban pilot who defects by swimming to Guantanamo Bay Naval Base and asking for political asylum. He arrives in Miami, and works as an FBI informant in addition to piloting for the Brothers. He buys expensive clothes, a Rolex, and settles down and marries Ana Margarita Martínez. After a few years, he flies back to Havana, revealing that he was a mole who had infiltrated anti-Castro associations.
After months and many bureaucratic procedures, Olga and her daughter are allowed to leave Cuba and rejoin René in Miami. But before their travel, Viramontez informs Olga that her husband is not a gusano (Spanish for worm) or a traitor to the Castro regime but indeed is a hero and a Cuban intelligence agent who infiltrated the CANF, which she must keep secret for the security of all of them and the Wasp Network.
In El Salvador in 1997, Raúl Cruz León is recruited by anti-Castroists to place C-4 bombs in Havana hotels. An Italian tourist dies and the same day he is caught by the Cuban police. After being caught the organization abandons him to his fate.
Finally, René González, Manuel Viramontez and the entire Wasp Network are captured by the FBI, all face charges of conspiracy to commit espionage, conspiracy to commit murder, acting as an agent of a foreign government, and other illegal activities in the United States and face long prison terms if found guilty in the Federal Court of judge Joan A. Lenard. In an interview Fidel Castro defends the actions of the agents and their program.
Despite the fact that the FBI offers to reduce his sentence in exchange for information, René refuses to cooperate.
Aftermath:

Olga Salanueva-González was deported to Cuba after 3 months in prison. She was later reunited with her daughters Irma and Ivette and campaigned for the liberation of her husband.
René González served 12 years in prison. He was released on 7 October 2011.

documents.title: The Guernsey Literary & Potato Peel Pie Society
documents.original_title: The Guernsey Literary & Potato Peel Pie Society
documents.overview: Free-spirited writer Juliet Ashton forms a life-changing bond with the delightful and eccentric Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society, when she decides to write about the book club they formed during the occupation of Guernsey in WWII.

documents.title: Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire
documents.overview: When the King Gareth dies, his potential heirs, twin grandchildren who possess the dragon’s unique strengths, use their inherited powers against each other to vie for the throne. When Drago’s source of power – known as the Heartfire – is stolen, more than the throne is at stake; the siblings must end their rivalry with swords and sorcery or the kingdom may fall.
documents.plot:
Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire is a 2017 fantasy adventure film directed by Patrik Syversen. The second prequel to Dragonheart (1996), it is set about 50 years after Dragonheart 3: The Sorcerer's Curse. Patrick Stewart voices the dragon Drago, with Tom Rhys Harries as Edric, Jessamine-Bliss Bell as his twin sister Mehgan, André Eriksen as the Viking Thorgrim and Marte Germaine Christensen as Sable.

King Gareth and Queen Rhonu have a son, Walter, who grows disillusioned with dragons and runs away. Years later, Walter's wife dies giving birth to twins who bear strange patches of scales, and Walter raises them alone. Twenty years on, Gareth dies, and Drago, whose heart he shared, survives because the bond has passed to someone new: Edric, a strong young sheriff serving Earl Robert Cole. Learning that Edric is Gareth's grandson, Drago persuades him to claim the throne at Lundenwic, but Edric proves arrogant and unprepared, and their bond is only partial. Edric then reveals a twin sister, Mehgan, outcast for her visible scales and power over fire. After their home burned down with Walter inside, Edric sent her away by boat to save her from the villagers.

When Vikings invade, Edric ignores Drago's advice and challenges their leader to a duel, only to discover that it is Mehgan. Drago explains the Heartfire, source of his fire. Mehgan claims the throne as the elder twin, and when Edric refuses, she drains the Heartfire from the sleeping Drago and seizes power. Banished and betrayed by Robert, Edric is rescued by Drago, who will die without the Heartfire, and a theatre troupe helps them into the castle. Mehgan, who has been improving women's rights, is attacked by Thorgrim's lieutenant Sable, and Thorgrim takes the Heartfire. Forced to fight, the twins confront the truth: Edric accidentally killed their father, and Mehgan took the blame. Reconciled, they retake the castle with the help of its women. Edric kills Thorgrim, who has been overwhelmed by the Heartfire's power, and when Mehgan is mortally wounded, Drago has the Heartfire used to heal her. The twins share the bond, losing their scales and powers, and Drago dies peacefully, becoming a star and urging them to rule together.

The film was released on Netflix, DVD and Blu-ray on June 13, 2017. Brian Costello of Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, calling it an entertaining medieval fantasy whose humor and brisk action make up for its weaker computer-generated dragon effects.

documents.plot: After a catastrophe destroys most of humanity, recluse Del lives in his small, empty town, content with the utopia he has methodically created for himself, until an interloper, young Grace, disrupts his solitude.

documents.title: Time Freak
documents.tagline: If at first you don't succeed, build a time machine.
documents.overview: Stillman, a heartbroken physics student, builds a time machine when his girlfriend breaks up with him. Going back in time, he attempts to save their relationship by fixing every mistake he made—while dragging his best friend along in the process.
documents.plot:
Time Freak, also known as Time After Time, is a 2018 American science fiction romantic comedy-drama written and directed by Andrew Bowler, expanding his 2011 short film of the same name. Asa Butterfield, Sophie Turner and Skyler Gisondo star, with Will Peltz and Aubrey Reynolds in supporting roles. It opened in limited release and on digital platforms on November 9, 2018.

Stillman, a gifted physics student, is devastated when his girlfriend Debbie breaks up with him. With his best friend Evan, he catalogues the moments of their relationship into good and bad memories, trying to pinpoint what went wrong, and in the midst of his heartbreak he finally succeeds in building a working time machine. The two friends travel back to the day Stillman and Debbie met, planning to fix every mistake along the way; Stillman will know he has succeeded if Debbie's final break-up text disappears from his phone.

What follows is a series of repeated do-overs. An outing with Debbie and their friends goes badly when the others mock Stillman's favourite film and he lashes out, so he rewinds until the evening goes his way. He relives other moments again and again, from a party that turns out to be a locked rooftop to a camping trip, while Evan tries to leave messages for his future self so that he will not flunk out. When the machine malfunctions it can only move them forward, forcing Stillman to get things right in a single attempt. Eventually the text vanishes, and the friends return to the present to find Stillman and Debbie still together.

The new reality soon proves hollow. Two years later the couple are married, but Debbie has lost interest in her music, notes that they never argue about anything, and is quietly unhappy, while Evan has become addicted to using the machine. Realising that his manipulation has made their life too perfect and stifled Debbie, Stillman resolves to destroy the device and, despite a fight with Evan, travels back once more to the day they first met. This time he lets go and walks away, before Debbie's future consciousness catches up with her and the two argue and finally make up.

The film made little commercial impact, grossing around $516,000 worldwide.

documents.title: Drone
documents.tagline: Choose your target wisely.
documents.overview: Ideologies collide with fatal results when a military drone contractor meets an enigmatic Pakistani businessman.
documents.plot:
Drone is a 2017 Canadian thriller directed by Jason Bourque. Sean Bean stars as Neil Wistin, a private contractor who flies drones for the CIA, with Patrick Sabongui as Imir Shaw, a Pakistani businessman, Mary McCormack as Wistin's wife Ellen, Maxwell Haynes as their son Shane and Joel David Moore as Gary.

In March 2016, a drone strike in Pakistan kills its target but also several innocent bystanders. A year later, on the anniversary of the strike, Shaw arrives in the American town where Wistin lives. Wistin is grieving his father and struggling with a eulogy and his distant son. While Wistin clears out his father's room at a care home, Shaw follows Ellen and photographs her meeting another man, revealing an affair. When Wistin returns home, he finds Shaw outside and is told that the visitor wants to buy the boat Wistin has put up for sale, which once belonged to his father. The two go inside to negotiate. At the same time, the CIA traces Shaw as the source of a leak that has exposed the identities of Wistin and other secret contract drone pilots.

Over dinner with the family, Shaw reveals that this is the first anniversary of the deaths of his wife and daughter, killed by a drone operator, and it is implied that Wistin was that operator. Wistin takes a phone call in his office, learns of the leak and checks his records for the date, which confirms his fears about his guest. When he confronts Shaw and moves to call the police, Shaw produces what appears to be a detonator and claims that the briefcase he left on the kitchen table, beside Ellen and Shane, contains explosives equivalent to a drone missile. He demands that Wistin tell his family the truth about his classified work. Wistin complies, and Shaw in turn tells him about Ellen's affair. A CIA tactical team surrounds the house and prepares to kill Shaw, but the two men start fighting, and Wistin stabs Shaw several times. As Shaw dies, Wistin discovers that there was no bomb. Changed by what he has done, Wistin publicly reveals the secret work of the CIA's contract drone operators, and he is hailed by some as a hero and condemned by others as a traitor.

 It premiered at the Vancouver International Film Festival in April 2017 and was released in U.S. theaters and on digital platforms on May 26, 2017. Reviews were generally unfavorable. Rotten Tomatoes reported 27% approval from 11 critics, and Metacritic gave it a score of 49 out of 100.

documents.title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas
documents.original_title: Tadeo Jones 2: El secreto del rey Midas
documents.overview: Tad dreams of becoming an archaeologist traveling the world, uncovering hidden secrets and lost treasure, but his job working construction keeps him daydreaming instead of exploring. The chance of a lifetime comes when he is invited to attend archaeologist Sara Lavrof's presentation of her latest discovery - the papyrus that proves the existence of the Necklace of Midas, the legendary King who turned everything he touched into solid gold.
documents.plot:
Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas (Spanish: Tadeo Jones 2: El secreto del rey Midas) is a 2017 Spanish computer-animated adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and David Alonso, the sequel to Tad, the Lost Explorer (2012). It features the voices of Óscar Barberán as Tad and Michelle Jenner as Sara. It premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June 2017 and was released in Spain by Paramount Pictures that August, later reaching the United States and United Kingdom.

Tad Stones, a construction worker who dreams of being a real archaeologist, is invited by his friend Sara Lavrof, now a renowned explorer, to a museum where she will present a papyrus proving that King Midas really existed. Before the visit Tad is reunited with Mummy, the friendly mummy from the first film, who has been thrown out of his home and travelled to find him. At the museum Tad meets Tiffany, the ambitious assistant of Sara's father, Professor Lavrof.

At a gala, Sara tells the legend of Midas: for defeating his enemies on behalf of Apollo, the king received a golden collar that gave him the power to turn everything he touched into gold. When he accidentally turned his own daughter into gold, Apollo ordered him to split the collar into three pieces and hide them in three temples, and his daughter was restored through a sacrifice of love. The villainous treasure hunter Jack Rackham and his henchmen burst in, steal the papyrus and kidnap Sara to force her to lead him to the pieces.

Tad, Tiffany and Mummy decipher notes about one of the temples and follow the kidnappers to Granada, where, after a chase through the Alhambra, they discover a secret passage under a fountain leading to a hidden temple and recover the first piece. Rackham forces them to hand it over in exchange for Sara. The search continues to Cappadocia in Turkey, where Tad finds the second piece and learns that a mountain shaped like Midas's symbol holds the last one.

Sara resolves to destroy the collar, but Tiffany betrays the group and joins Rackham. Everyone converges on the mountain, where Rackham assembles the collar and gains Midas's golden touch. In the struggle he turns Sara to gold before Tad defeats him. As Tad grieves over her, his love restores her, just as in the legend. The film earned about 35.7 million dollars worldwide against a budget of nine million euros, and won the Goya Award for Best Animated Film.
production_companies: Tadeo Jones y el Secreto de Midas A.I.E.

documents.title: Serenity
documents.tagline: On Plymouth Island, no one ever dies… unless you break the rules
documents.overview: The quiet life of Baker Dill, a fishing boat captain who lives on the isolated Plymouth Island, where he spends his days obsessed with capturing an elusive tuna while fighting his personal demons, is interrupted when someone from his past comes to him searching for help.
documents.plot:
Serenity is a 2019 American mystery thriller written, produced and directed by Steven Knight. It stars Matthew McConaughey as a fishing boat captain whose ex-wife asks him to kill her abusive husband, with Anne Hathaway, Diane Lane, Jason Clarke, Djimon Hounsou and Jeremy Strong. Initially announced as a "sexy noir", the film turns on a twist that recasts its tropical setting as something other than it appears.

Baker Dill runs fishing tours from the placid Plymouth Island and spends his days fixated on a giant yellowfin tuna he calls "Justice". His routine is upended when his ex-wife Karen tracks him down and pleads with him to rescue her and their young son Patrick from her wealthy, violent new husband, Frank. She offers Dill $10 million to take Frank out on a fishing trip later that week and throw him overboard. Torn between his conscience and his feelings for Karen, Dill is drawn back toward a past he had tried to escape, and the island begins to reveal strange inconsistencies. It emerges that Dill is a character in a computer game built by Patrick and modelled on his real father, John Mason, a Marine captain killed in Iraq in 2006; Patrick based the character on a memory of being taken fishing by his father at the age of three. After his widowed mother remarried an abusive man, Patrick added Karen and Frank to the game and changed its goal from catching the tuna to killing his stepfather. Realising that he and the islanders are artificial creations of his son, Dill chooses to carry out the task anyway. As he does so, Patrick confronts Frank in reality and stabs him with his father's knife. Charged with murder but released into his mother's custody pending trial, Patrick designs a new game in which he and his father are together again.

McConaughey plays Dill, Hathaway plays Karen and Clarke plays Frank, with Lane, who replaced Uma Thurman, as Dill's love interest. Produced and financed through IM Global, it was shot in Mauritius from July 2017, where funding for the production became a political scandal. After poor test screenings, Aviron Pictures cut its marketing almost entirely, and the film opened on January 25, 2019 to a $4.4 million weekend, grossing $14.4 million worldwide on a $25 million budget. Critics derided the twist, giving it 21% on Rotten Tomatoes, audiences gave it a "D+" CinemaScore, and McConaughey and Hathaway received Golden Raspberry nominations.

documents.overview: The countryside isn't always as calm and peaceful as it's made out to be, and the animals on this farm are particularly agitated: a fox who mothers a family of chicks, a rabbit who plays the stork, and a duck who wants to be Santa Claus.

documents.title: Ava
documents.overview: Ava, 13, is spending the summer on the Atlantic coast when she learns that she will lose her sight sooner than expected. Her mother decides to act as if everything were normal so as to spend their best summer ever. Ava confronts the problem in her own way. She steals a big black dog that belongs to a young man on the run...
documents.plot:
Ava is an unhappy 13-year-old, who is losing her sight from Retinitis Pigmentosa – a genetic condition which leads to her losing her night sight, then her peripheral vision, followed by total blindness. She is determined to live life to the full while she can see, exploring her approaching blindness and her constant nightmares which keep her awake at night.
She is attracted to an 18-year-old, Juan and his dog, who she names Lupo. Juan is a traveler in love with Jessica, over whom he fights but is stabbed. Ava comes across the wounded Juan, helping him to recover. Once he is better, they embark on a spree of robberies at the beach, helping Ava to cope with her sadness. This, and the fact that Juan is having sex with Ava, a minor, gets Juan into trouble with the police.
They escape from the police and Ava offers to help Juan recover his car keys and papers from his caravan so they can run away together. Ava joins Jessica's wedding on the traveler site to wait tables, then slips away when the cake is served. She finds Juan's wallet and driving license but can't find his car keys.
The police raid the wedding so that Juan and Ava are forced to run away without his car. While they are walking away, Jessica appears to give Juan his car, leaving her veil with Ava as a token of her love and support for the couple.

documents.title: Los perros
documents.overview: Mariana, an upper-class Chilean, feels a strange attraction towards her riding teacher, Juan, a former colonel with a shady past.

documents.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
documents.original_title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
documents.tagline: Enter a new dimension of Strange.
documents.overview: Doctor Strange, with the help of mystical allies both old and new, traverses the mind-bending and dangerous alternate realities of the Multiverse to confront a mysterious new adversary.
documents.plot:
A demon chases America Chavez and a variant of Stephen Strange in the space between universes while searching for the Book of Vishanti. Strange is killed and Chavez accidentally creates a portal that transports herself and Strange's corpse to Earth-616, where that universe's version of Stephen Strange rescues Chavez from another demon with help from Wong, the Sorcerer Supreme. Chavez explains that the beings are hunting her because she has the power to travel through the multiverse, but is unable to consciously control it.
Recognizing witchcraft runes on the demon, Strange consults Wanda Maximoff but soon realizes that she is responsible for the attacks. After acquiring the Darkhold and becoming the Scarlet Witch, Wanda believes that taking Chavez's powers and traveling through the multiverse will allow her to reunite with Billy and Tommy, the children she created during her time in Westview. When Strange refuses to surrender Chavez, Wanda attacks Kamar-Taj, kills many sorcerers, and captures Wong. Chavez accidentally transports herself and Strange to Earth-838. Wanda uses the Darkhold to "dreamwalk", taking control of her Earth-838 counterpart who lives a suburban life with her own Billy and Tommy. After a surviving sorceress, Sara, sacrifices herself to destroy the Darkhold and break the dreamwalk, an enraged Wanda forces Wong to lead her to Mount Wundagore, the source of the Darkhold's power, to reestablish the dreamwalk.
While searching for help, Strange and Chavez are apprehended by Earth-838's Sorcerer Supreme, Karl Mordo, and brought before the Illuminati, a group consisting of Mordo, Peggy Carter, Blackagar Boltagon, Maria Rambeau, Reed Richards, and Charles Xavier. They explain that through reckless use of their universe's Darkhold in an attempt to defeat Thanos, Earth-838's Strange triggered a universe-destroying "incursion". After defeating Thanos, the Illuminati executed their Strange to prevent him from causing more harm. Mordo believes that Earth-616's Strange is similarly dangerous, but Wanda reestablishes her dreamwalk at Mount Wundagore and arrives in her Earth-838 counterpart's body before the Illuminati can pass judgment. She brutally kills all the Illuminati except Mordo, whom Strange subdues before fleeing with Chavez. The two escape with help from the Earth-838 version of Strange's ex-fiancé, Christine Palmer, a scientist working with the Illuminati.
Strange, Chavez, and Palmer enter the space between universes to find the Book of Vishanti, which is the antithesis of the Darkhold, but Wanda appears and destroys it. She then takes over Chavez's mind and uses her powers to send Strange and Palmer to an incursion-destroyed universe. Strange defeats the destroyed universe's Strange, who has been corrupted by his Darkhold, and then uses that Darkhold to dreamwalk into the body of his deceased counterpart on Earth-616. With Wong's help, Strange saves Chavez from Wanda and encourages Chavez to use her abilities.

documents.title: Arctic
documents.tagline: Survival is the only option
documents.overview: A man stranded in the Arctic is finally about to receive his long awaited rescue. However, after a tragic accident, his opportunity is lost and he must then decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his camp or embark on a deadly trek through the unknown for potential salvation.

documents.title: God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness
documents.original_title: God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness
documents.overview: Pastor Dave  responds to the unimaginable tragedy of having his church, located on the grounds of the local university, burned down.
documents.plot:
God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness is a 2018 American Christian drama film directed by Harold Cronk and written by Brian Godfrey. The movie serves as a sequel to the 2014 film God's Not Dead.

The story follows Josh Wheaton (played by Benjamin Ochieng), a former atheist who has become a successful lawyer, but struggles with his faith after the death of his wife. He is approached by a Christian radio host, Reverend Dave (played by David A.R. White), who asks for his help in finding a replacement to fill in on his show.

Josh agrees and starts hosting the show, where he begins to reconnect with his faith and shares his story with his listeners. However, he soon faces opposition from his new boss, who is an atheist, and struggles to balance his work and personal life.

Meanwhile, Josh's daughter, Bethany (played by Marisa Brownlee), is struggling in school due to her father's absence and lack of involvement in her life. She begins to question God's existence and feels abandoned by her father.

As Josh navigates his new role on the radio show, he faces challenges from his atheist colleagues and struggles to reconcile his past and present faith. He also starts to rebuild his relationship with Bethany, who is initially resistant to his involvement in her life.

Throughout the movie, Josh's story serves as a catalyst for exploring themes of faith, family, and redemption. The film features a mix of drama, comedy, and inspiration, as Josh's journey takes him from darkness to light.

The title "A Light in Darkness" refers to the biblical concept of God being present even in the midst of adversity and hardship. The movie suggests that even in the darkest moments, there is always hope for redemption and forgiveness through faith.

Ultimately, Josh comes to terms with his past and finds a way to reconnect with Bethany and rebuild their relationship. He also finds a new sense of purpose and meaning in his life as he shares his story with others and helps them find hope and inspiration.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Josh's radio show becoming a beacon of light for those seeking guidance and comfort. The film concludes by emphasizing the importance of faith, family, and community in overcoming adversity and finding redemption.

Overall, God's Not Dead: A Light in Darkness is a heartwarming and inspiring film that explores themes of faith, family, and redemption. With its uplifting message and engaging storyline, it is sure to leave audiences feeling hopeful and motivated.

documents.title: Night School
documents.overview: Teddy Walker is a successful salesman whose life takes an unexpected turn when he accidentally blows up his place of employment. Forced to attend night school to get his GED, Teddy soon finds himself dealing with a group of misfit students, his former high school nemesis and a feisty teacher who doesn't think he's too bright.
